title: Long-Form YouTube Outliner & Researcher | Ongoing Work
description:
Kirschmann Media is looking for an experienced YouTube Outliner & Researcher for the Chaz Kirschmann YouTube channel.

We're looking for someone who can independently research assigned topics and turn their findings into engaging, accurate, and well-structured outlines for long-form YouTube videos.



YouTube Channel: 



RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Conduct thorough, independent research using credible sources.

• Develop engaging Outlines that align with the channel's voice, tone, and commentary style.

• Organize information, events, and timelines into a cohesive narrative.

• Gather supporting evidence, including source links, screenshots, clips, and accurate timestamps.

• Fact-check claims, verify attributions, and preserve relevant context.

• Follow our research and writing template and implement feedback as needed.



All research and writing must be original. Copying or paraphrasing other creators' content is strictly prohibited. All internal materials and unpublished content must remain confidential.



REQUIREMENTS:



• Experience in YouTube outlines and content research.

• Strong English writing, storytelling, and research skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and critical thinking skills.

• Ability to distinguish verified facts from allegations and speculation.

• Familiarity with YouTube commentary and internet culture.

• Reliable communication, consistent turnaround, and openness to feedback.

• AI Usage Policy: No AI Usage allowed



WORKLOAD & COMPENSATION:



• Work Arrangement: Remote, project-based

• Video Length: 60–90 minutes

• Workload: 1–2 scripts per week

• Turnaround Time: 2–3 days per assignment

• Rate: $100-$150



This is an ongoing opportunity for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship with our team.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please submit the following:



• A brief introduction and relevant experience.

• Two relevant scriptwriting or research samples with links to the finished videos.

• A brief explanation of your research and writing process.

• Your availability and expected turnaround time.



Shortlisted applicants will receive our research training guide and template, which Chaz will personally walk through during the interview.

title: GHL Outbound Appointment Setter
description:
GHL Outbound Appointment Setter (Home Service Industry) – Full-Time, Remote



About the Role

We are hiring a GHL Outbound Appointment Setter for a fast-growing US marketing agency that serves home service businesses, mainly window cleaning, power washing, and exterior and interior cleaning companies. This role is for someone who loves talking to people, isn't afraid of objections, and wants to grow with the business.



Key Responsibilities

1. Outbound Calling and Prospecting

- Make daily outbound and cold calls to a large list of existing customers and to
 ad leads

- Prospect and qualify home service business owners

- Explain the offer in simple, clear terms to a non-technical audience

- Handle early objections with patience and persistence



2. Booking Appointments

- Book webinar registrations and drive webinar views

- Book qualified prospects into one-on-one sales calls with the owner, who handles all closing



3. Pipeline Management

- Manage leads and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel

- Prioritize leads so the best opportunities are contacted first

- Keep all lead records organized and up to date in the CRM



Qualifications

Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear, confident phone voice

Experience in outbound calling, cold calling, appointment setting, or sales development

GoHighLevel experience (pipelines, contacts, and the dialer)

Able to explain complex ideas in simple words

Strong active listening skills

Resilient and persistent when handling objections

Organized and able to manage a high volume of leads

Self-directed. You can work with little supervision.

Deadline- and metrics-driven

Comfortable using Slack. ClickUp and ChatGPT experience is a plus.



Who We're Looking For

Someone with personality who enjoys talking to people

An operator, not just a task doer

Always looking for ways to improve and do more

Wants to grow with the business and be rewarded for results



Schedule and Work Setup

Full-time, remote

Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time

Must have a reliable computer, a stable internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace



How to Apply

Apply through this OnlineJobs.ph posting. Please include:

Your resume

A short voice recording or video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, as if you were calling a business owner for the first time

A short summary of your outbound calling or appointment setting experience, including any results (calls per day, appointments booked)



Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

description:
# Shopify Store Manager & GemPages Expert



We are looking for an experienced **Shopify Store Manager & GemPages Expert** to help manage the daily operations of multiple ecommerce stores.



This is a hands-on role. You must be comfortable managing Shopify stores independently, building pages, creating products, integrating apps, and troubleshooting store issues.



## Main Requirements



You must have strong experience with:



* **GemPages**, advanced experience required

* **Shopify store management**

* Creating and managing Shopify products

* Shopify product pages and landing pages

* Shopify app installation, setup, integration, and management

* **Shopify Theme Liquid**, basic to intermediate knowledge required

* **Fileflare**, especially for ebook/digital product delivery

* **Kaching Bundles**

* **Kaching Subscriptions**

* **One Click Upsell / OCU**

* Shopify themes and store customization



## Responsibilities



* Manage Shopify stores and their daily operations

* Create, edit, and manage products

* Build and modify pages using GemPages

* Recreate existing or competitor pages in GemPages

* Manage Shopify apps and integrations

* Setup bundles, subscriptions, and upsells

* Setup Fileflare ebook/digital product delivery

* Troubleshoot Shopify and app issues

* Make basic Shopify Liquid/theme adjustments

* Check store functionality and fix issues

* Update offers, pricing, products, and store content

* Maintain desktop and mobile page responsiveness

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper and Finance Automation (E-commerce / DTC)

-Fully remote

-Full-time (150+ hours per month)

-Flexible schedule with 7.5 hours a day overlapping Philippines and Spain time zones

-Pay: Competitive, depending on experience



ABOUT US

We run several health and wellness e-commerce brands that bring in 7-figure revenue every month. We sell through our own stores and Amazon, grow through direct response marketing, creative testing and funnel optimization, and we're aiming for 9-figure annual revenue.



WHY JOIN US

- Keep the books of 8-figure DTC brands across 2 US companies, 1 UK company and 2 Hong Kong entities.

- Help build an in-house bookkeeping function from the ground up.

- Build AI agents and automations that change how finance works, rather than just using other people's tools.

- Work directly with our Finance Manager and see the full finance picture of a fast-growing, multi-entity business.

- Join an ambitious, fast-moving team that rewards both accuracy and speed.



THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH

You'll work under our Finance Manager, who owns the books and signs off every close. The job has two halves. The first is hands-on bookkeeping: you'll take over daily entries and reconciliations from an outsourced provider, and today most of that work is manual and high-volume. The second is shrinking that manual work: you'll build AI agents, automations and simple systems that take over the repetitive parts, so the books get faster and more accurate every month. You need to be good at both.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Daily

- Record every transaction in QuickBooks Online for each entity, including sales, payouts, processor fees, refunds and adjustments that don't sync automatically.

- Categorize every transaction against the chart of accounts (ad spend, COGS, shipping and fulfillment, SaaS, contractors) and by brand, and suggest changes to the chart for the Finance Manager to approve.

- Check the daily fulfillment partner bills against the orders shipped, and flag any billing errors before they are paid.

- Handle payables and receivables: enter vendor bills, prepare payment runs for the Finance Manager to approve, and track refunds, processor reserves and receipts.



Weekly

- Send the Finance Manager a cash position for each entity, to feed the cash forecast.

- Track chargebacks and disputes from open to closed, and book losses and reserve releases.



Monthly

- Prepare the month-end close for every entity on a fixed calendar (accruals, prepaids, deferrals and adjusting entries), ready for the Finance Manager to review and sign off.

- Reconcile all bank, credit card, loan and balance sheet accounts.

- Reconcile Shopify sales, refunds, discounts, chargebacks and fees against payouts from Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe and other processors.

- Reconcile Amazon Seller Central settlement reports (fees, refunds, reserves, FBA charges) to deposits.

- Book ad spend from Meta, Google and other ad platform invoices and match it to card charges.

- Book subscription and membership revenue correctly, including deferred revenue for annual plans.

- Record and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances between entities, keeping consolidated books accurate and audit-ready.

- Book inventory, landed costs and COGS.

- Record payroll and contractor payments.

- Reconcile sales tax collected and payable against the filings managed in Numeral.

- Reconcile our management spreadsheets to QuickBooks, and help move them into one source of truth.

- Review software subscriptions and flag any that are unused or duplicated.

- Draft a P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statement for each entity, plus consolidated views and a contribution margin view for each brand, for the Finance Manager to review.



Yearly and ongoing

- Prepare schedules and supporting documents for year-end: the US tax package and 1099s with our CPA, and the Hong Kong audit and profits tax filings with our auditors and company secretary.

- Write down every recurring process, so the books are always audit-ready and easy to hand over.

- When an error keeps coming back, raise it with the Finance Manager and suggest a fix to the process.



Building automation

- Find the most repetitive, error-prone tasks in the books and automate them first, such as transaction categorization, payout matching, fulfillment bill checks, receipt collection and intercompany entries.

- Build and maintain AI agents and automations for finance, for example an agent that matches Shopify and processor payouts to bank deposits, or one that flags unusual transactions before the close.

- Connect our tools (QuickBooks Online, Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Numeral, Google Sheets) through their APIs or automation platforms.

- Document how each automation works, what it touches and how to switch it off, so someone else can run it.

- Track how many hours each automation saves and its error rate, and report both to the Finance Manager every month.



HOW WE WORK

- You prepare, and the Finance Manager approves. You won't have authority to release payments.

- Automations and AI agents use only tools the Finance Manager approves. Financial and customer data never goes into unapproved AI tools.

- Any automation that posts to the books needs Finance Manager sign-off before it goes live, has a person reviewing its output, and keeps a record of every change.

- You'll sign an NDA. Access is granted by role and removed when you leave.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- First 30 days: you've taken over the daily entries and reconciliations, every account is reconciled, and you've listed the top five tasks to automate.

- First 90 days: every entity's close is ready for Finance Manager review by business day 8 of each month, and your first automation is live with checks in place.

- First 6 months: you've automated the bulk of the payout matching and categorization work, and the close is measurably faster with no drop in accuracy.



MUST-HAVES

- 3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping, ideally for e-commerce or DTC brands.

- You've run a full monthly close yourself, start to finish.

- You use QuickBooks Online every day: journal entries, reconciliations, classes/locations and reporting.

- You've reconciled Shopify and payment processor payouts to bank deposits.

- Amazon Seller Central settlement reconciliation.

- You've kept books for more than one company, including intercompany entries.

- Solid grasp of accrual accounting (US GAAP basics).

- Your reconciliations tie out to the cent, and you write down what you do.

- Inventory and landed cost accounting for physical products.

- US sales tax experience with Numeral, TaxJar or Avalara.

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills (pivots, lookups, simple models).



NICE TO HAVE

- You've built working automations or AI agents for bookkeeping or finance tasks, and you can show us one (an n8n or Make workflow, a Python script, a Google Apps Script, or an agent built on Claude or ChatGPT).

- Hong Kong company experience (HKFRS, audit preparation, profits tax).

- Experience supporting transfer pricing documentation.

- A2X, 
, Ramp, Expensify or similar tools.

- Moving a company off an outsourced bookkeeper and cleaning up historical books.

- Working with APIs (QuickBooks Online, Shopify, Stripe or similar).

- Setting up controls and audit trails around automated postings.

- CPA, ACCA, CMA or QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.



YOU'LL FIT IN IF YOU

- Won't hand over a close with an unreconciled difference, however small.

- Spot problems and raise them with the Finance Manager before anyone asks.

- Keep a tight close calendar and get faster without cutting corners.

- Can explain what the numbers mean, in plain English, to people outside finance.

- Want to get rid of manual work by automating it.

- Are great at prioritizing and solving constraints before the easy work.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: 

You will need to answer a set of technical screening questions.



Our process: Form review > Technical interview with the Finance Manager > Final interview and offer

title: CRO Developer (Shopify / Landing Pages)
description:
- Fully remote

- Full-time (150+ hours per month) or Part-time (around 80 hours per month) 

- Flexible schedule



COMPANY OVERVIEW

We operate multiple successful e-commerce brands in the health & wellness sectors, consistently achieving 7-figure monthly revenues. Our brands are heavily focused on direct response marketing, creative testing, and funnel optimization. We are scaling aggressively toward 9-figure annual revenue.



WHY JOIN US

- Build the landing pages and product pages that carry the traffic of 8-figure DTC brands.

- See your work go live fast and measure its impact directly in conversion rate and revenue.

- Own page code quality and site speed end to end, with the freedom to set the standards.

- Work closely with our CRO designers and growth team in a fast, test-driven environment.

- Full-time or part-time: we care about output and quality, not hours on the clock.



ROLE SUMMARY

As our CRO Developer, you will turn static designs (mostly from Figma) into live, high-converting landing pages and product pages on our Shopify stores. Our CRO designers create the pages; you build them pixel-perfect, make them fast and responsive, and deploy them so we can launch and test new funnels quickly.



You also own the technical quality of our pages: clean, maintainable code, fast load times and strong Core Web Vitals on mobile. Our designers and growth team own the ideas and the tests. You own making sure every page ships quickly, works on every device and loads fast.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Turn static Figma designs into pixel-perfect, fully responsive landing pages, product pages and funnel pages.

- Build and deploy pages on Shopify (Liquid, sections and templates), including custom sections that our team can reuse.

- Ship new pages and test variations quickly, so our growth team can launch new funnels and A/B tests without waiting.

- Own page speed and performance: Core Web Vitals, image and asset optimization, lazy loading, and cutting heavy scripts and apps.

- Keep page code clean, reusable and well documented, and refactor what slows us down.

- Set up and QA A/B tests with our testing tools, and make sure variants render correctly across devices and browsers.

- Make sure tracking and analytics (pixels, events, tags) fire correctly on every page you build.

- QA every page on mobile and desktop before launch, and fix bugs and layout issues fast.

- Audit existing pages for speed, code quality and conversion blockers, and propose fixes.

- Use AI tools to speed up development where it makes sense, without lowering quality.



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)

- Proven Front-End Experience: 3+ years building websites and landing pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

- Shopify Development: Hands-on experience with Shopify themes, Liquid, sections and templates.

- Design to Code: You turn Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive pages, and you can show live examples.

- Page Speed Expertise: You know how to diagnose and improve Core Web Vitals and load times, and can show before/after results.

- Clean Code: You write code that is readable, reusable and easy for the next person to work with.

- Mobile-First Mindset: Most of our traffic is mobile, and your pages look and work great on every screen size.

- Speed of Execution: You can take a design and have a live, tested page up quickly, often within days.

- Portfolio: Links to live landing pages or e-commerce stores you have built.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience with DTC, e-commerce or direct response funnels (advertorials, listicles, quizzes, upsells).

- Experience with A/B testing tools such as Intelligems, Shoplift, VWO or Convert.

- Experience with page builders such as Replo, GemPages or Shogun.

- Familiarity with tracking setup: Meta Pixel and Conversions API, GA4, Google Tag Manager.

- Experience with headless Shopify, Hydrogen, Next.js or similar frameworks.

- Basic understanding of CRO principles and what makes a page convert.

- Comfortable with Git and a simple deployment workflow.



IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

- Detail-Oriented: The live page matches the design down to the pixel, on every device.

- Performance-Obsessed: A slow page bothers you, and you don't stop until it is fast.

- Fast & Reliable: You hit deadlines and ship without being chased.

- Ownership Mindset: You treat our pages like your own and flag issues before anyone asks.

- Clear Communicator: You give honest timelines and explain technical trade-offs in plain English.



WORK STRUCTURE

- Full-time: 150+ hours per month, or Part-time: around 80 hours per month.

- Flexible schedule, with some overlap with our team's working hours.

- Fully remote with a high-performance, fast-moving culture.



IMPORTANT

This is a hands-on, execution-heavy development role. A large part of your work will be turning designs into live pages quickly and keeping our pages fast and clean. We are looking for a developer who takes pride in pixel-perfect, high-performance pages, ships fast, and wants to see the direct impact of their work on conversion rates and revenue. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.



TO APPLY

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter (US Septic Companies) - Part-Time, Performance-Based
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

This is a PERFORMANCE-BASED job. You get $3/hour base plus a $50 bonus for every client who signs from a demo you booked. So far, 2 out of 3 booked demo calls have signed. That could change, but the more demos you are able to book, the more you earn.



What you can earn:

- Hit the goal: 5 demos a week -> about 3 sign -> $36 + $150 = about $186 a week for 12 hours of work

- Top performer: 7+ demos a week -> about 5 sign -> $36 + $250 = about $286 a week for 12 hours of work



Leads are provided. You never search for leads. Every lead is a real US septic company already loaded in our CRM.



We set everything up for you. You get a login to our CRM (Podio) and our power dialer (smrtPhone), with your leads, scripts and phone numbers ready. Log in and start dialing.



TRAINING: Before you start, you'll learn our CRM process and how to handle every type of call: which script to use, how to book a demo, how to set a status and note in Podio, and how to work your follow-up tasks. It's all in a simple step-by-step playbook and doesn't take long to learn.



SCHEDULE (Philippine time):

- 8:00-9:00 PM, Monday-Thursday

- 6:00-8:00 AM, Tuesday-Friday

That's 7-8 AM and 5-7 PM US Eastern, Monday-Thursday, when owners pick up. Times move 1 hour earlier when US daylight saving time starts in March. About 12 hours a week to start, with more hours for top performers.



Christmas week (December 21-25) is off.



WEEKLY GOALS

- 5 booked demos a week. 7 or more makes you a top performer.

- Aim for
dials a week. Demos that close matter more than a high dial count.



ABOUT US

CallServe AI builds AI phone receptionists for small US septic companies. Our AI answers calls owners miss when they're out on a job or after hours, then quotes and books the work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call septic company owners through our power dialer, one call at a time, using our script

- Have short, friendly conversations and book a 30-minute demo call with our founder

- Work your follow-up tasks in Podio first, then new leads

- Set a status and a one-line note in Podio after every call

- Book demos only. Our founder runs the demo and closes the sale.



REQUIREMENTS

- A CLEAR ENGLISH ACCENT. If you don't have one, please do not apply. Our clients are small-town US business owners, and they need to understand you easily.

- US cold calling or appointment setting experience. Home services (roofing, solar, HVAC, plumbing) is a plus.

- Stays upbeat and keeps dialing through "no"s and hang-ups

- Reliable internet plus a backup (mobile data or a power backup), a quiet room, and a noise-canceling headset

- Experience with a CRM or power dialer is a plus, but we'll train you on ours



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send a 1-2 minute voice recording of you reading this opener as if on a real call:

"Hey, is this the owner? Hey, my name's [your name]. Did I catch you in the truck or at a desk? ... Quick question: when you're out on a job or after hours, who's answering the calls you can't get to?"

2. Tell us about your cold calling experience: what you called for, how many dials a day, and your appointment-setting results.

3. Start your application with the word "SEPTIC".



Shortlisted applicants do a short live role-play call.

title: Real Estate Accountant
description:
Real Estate Accountant

Beacons Group LLC

Part-Time  ·  Remote  ·  Compensation: DOE



About Beacons

Beacons is a family-owned real estate investment company based in Rancho Santa Fe, California. We own and operate a growing portfolio of long-term rental properties, renovation and resale projects, and a short-term rental, held across multiple LLCs. We are an active buyer — including acquisitions funded through 1031 exchanges — and we run our financial operations with the discipline of a much larger firm: property-level books, a fixed month-end close calendar, and weekly reporting by property.



The Role

The Real Estate Accountant owns the day-to-day accounting for the portfolio. You will keep clean, property-level books, run the month-end close on schedule, and produce the weekly and monthly reporting ownership relies on to make acquisition, financing, and renovation decisions. This is a hands-on, part-time, fully remote role in a small, fast-moving family office — accuracy and follow-through matter more here than hierarchy.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain complete, accurate books for each property and LLC, with every transaction coded to the correct property, category, and cost center

• Run the month-end close on a fixed calendar — statements and cutoff, reconciliations, journal entries and variance review, reporting package, sign-off, and period lock — completed by day 7

• Produce weekly profit & loss and cash flow reporting by property and consolidated in Reach, plus a consolidated monthly balance sheet

• Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts monthly; research and clear exceptions promptly

• Manage rental accounting: rent rolls, tenant ledgers, and security deposit accounting

• Account for a variety of debt — conventional mortgages, interest-only private loans, a HELOC, and construction/bridge financing — including principal, interest, and escrow breakouts from lender statements

• Record balance sheet entries for real estate investment activity: acquisitions, dispositions, loan fundings and payoffs, escrow and earnest money deposits, 1031 exchange balances, and capital contributions and distributions

• Track renovation and construction costs by property (job costing), including budget vs. actual and contractor payment history

• Support acquisitions and dispositions: review closing statements, post settlement entries, coordinate with escrow, and track 1031 exchange funds and deadlines

• Book tax entries in a separate, dedicated location so property-level operating results stay clean

• Prepare annual tax workpapers (Schedule E), depreciation schedules, and supporting documentation for the outside CPA

title: Technical SEO Specialist
description:
About us and the websites

We're a small, specialist drinks development consultancy with offices in the UK and the UAE. We develop drink recipes for start-ups and established brands.

We have two websites, and together they bring in our leads:

• Our UK site, for the UK and Europe. This is getting traction and is the priority.

• Our UAE site, for the UAE and GCC. Enquiries have gone quiet and need recovering.

Both run on WordPress with Elementor, Yoast SEO and the Redirection plugin, hosted with HostPresto. Our web developer, Dee, builds and publishes all changes. During 2026 we have cleaned up both sites, redirected hundreds of old posts and rebuilt the key service pages.

The role

We're looking for a part-time technical SEO specialist to keep both sites healthy in Google and grow enquiries, starting in January 2027.

• Hours: about [X] hours a week to begin with, agreed in advance each week.

• Rate: [hourly rate], paid monthly against approved hours.

• Priorities, in order:

a. Keep the UK site growing: indexing, redirects, internal links, titles and descriptions.

b. Find out why the UAE site has gone quiet, and fix it.

c. Report clearly each week on what changed and what it did.

What you'll do, and what you won't

You will:

• Monitor Google Search Console and fix indexing problems: server errors, 404s, redirect errors and pages Google crawls but doesn't index.

• Plan redirects and merges of weaker old posts, for Richard's approval.

• Improve page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and schema.

• Check site speed and technical health, and flag hosting or plugin problems.

• Keep Bing Webmaster Tools and the Google Business Profiles in good order.

• Give Dee clear, step-by-step instructions for each approved change, then check it on the live site.

You won't:

• Write articles, blog posts or page copy in Richard's name. Articles under his name use his words. If an article needs more depth, you send Richard questions and build the extra section from his answers.

• Publish anything under another person's name to get round this.

• Use AI-generated images. Real photos or none.

• Start any task, or log any hours, without written approval first.

How we work

1. Plan first. For each task, send a short plan with the estimated hours. Work starts only when Richard approves it in writing.

2. Dee builds. You send Dee the approved instructions. You don't need WordPress admin access.

3. Log every change. Add each change to our SEO change log, with the date it went live, the page and what changed.

4. Report weekly. Every Friday, send four figures for each site: sitemap pages indexed, clicks, impressions and enquiries, with a few lines on what changed.

5. Track your hours. Keep an hours log for each task and send it with your monthly invoice. We only pay approved, logged hours.

6. Access. You get only the access each task needs, usually a user account on Search Console. You never get owner or administrator rights.

Who we're looking for

• At least 3 years of hands-on technical SEO on WordPress sites.

• Confident with Google Search Console, Yoast, the Redirection plugin and schema markup.

• Experience recovering a site after a large clean-up or migration, with examples you can show.

• Clear written English, and instructions a developer can follow step by step.

• Comfortable working to approval, not on your own initiative.

• Experience with UAE or GCC search is a plus.

• Two references from clients we can contact.

Paid trial task

Before any ongoing work, shortlisted applicants do one paid trial of up to 4 hours: a review of why our UAE site has gone quiet.

We give you view-only access to the UAE site's Search Console. Then send us a short written report covering:

1. The three most likely reasons UAE clicks and enquiries have dropped, with the evidence for each.

2. The five changes you'd make first, in order, with estimated hours for each.

3. One example of the instructions you'd give Dee for your first change.

We judge it on accuracy, clarity and whether you stayed within the rules above. Making changes to the site, or recommending new content in Richard's name, counts against you. Access is removed when the trial ends, whatever the outcome.

ONLY relevant applicants will get a response

title: HR Lead – Recruitment & People Operations
description:
About the Opportunity



We are a growing US-based home care organization looking for an experienced and results-driven HR Lead to strengthen our recruitment efforts and help build a more structured and effective HR function.



This is a hands-on leadership role with opportunities for growth.



Our immediate priority is recruitment. You will be responsible for managing and executing the recruitment function, ensuring we consistently attract, screen, and hire qualified caregivers who meet our operational and scheduling needs.

As the organization grows, this role will expand into broader HR leadership, including employee onboarding, retention, performance management, administrative oversight, and team development.



We're looking for someone who can execute independently today while helping us build stronger people and operational systems for the future.



Key Responsibilities

1. Recruitment Management & Execution (Primary Focus)

-Own and manage the end-to-end caregiver recruitment process, from sourcing and screening to interviewing, selection, and hiring coordination.

-Develop and execute recruitment strategies to maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates.

-Ensure candidates are thoroughly screened for qualifications, reliability, availability, and alignment with operational staffing needs.

-Work closely with Scheduling to understand workforce gaps and prioritize hiring accordingly.

-Conduct interviews, evaluate candidates, and coordinate with hiring managers on final selection.

-Manage recruitment platforms and explore alternative sourcing channels to improve applicant quality.

-Monitor recruitment KPIs, including applicant-to-hire ratio, cost per hire, hiring conversion, and new hire activation.

-Identify recruitment bottlenecks and implement improvements to increase hiring efficiency and quality.

-Maintain accurate recruitment records, trackers, and reports.



2. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

-Coordinate new hire onboarding, documentation, and employment requirements.

-Help improve employee onboarding and early retention processes.

-Maintain organized employee records, compliance documentation, and HR tracking systems.

-Support employee engagement, performance management, and employee relations processes.

-Develop and standardize HR policies, procedures, and workflows in collaboration with leadership.



3. Team Leadership & Process Improvement

-Provide guidance, coaching, and accountability to recruitment team members as the function develops.

-Establish clear recruitment processes, performance expectations, and reporting standards.

-Identify opportunities to improve collaboration between Recruitment, Scheduling, and Operations.

-Build practical SOPs, checklists, and systems that support consistent execution.

-Proactively identify problems, recommend solutions, and take ownership of implementation.

-As the role expands, assume greater responsibility for HR and administrative functions, including team oversight.





Qualifications

-At least 3 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR, with substantial hands-on end-to-end recruitment experience.

-Previous experience as a Recruitment Lead, HR Lead, Recruitment Supervisor, Talent Acquisition Specialist, or similar role with demonstrated ownership of recruitment outcomes.

-Strong candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection skills.

-Experience managing recruitment pipelines and using ATS or recruitment platforms.

-Ability to track, analyze, and improve recruitment performance metrics.

-Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

-Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

-Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and consistently meet deadlines.

-Willingness to work during US Central Time business hours.



Preferred

-Experience recruiting for US-based companies, particularly in healthcare, home care, staffing, or other high-volume recruitment environments.

-Experience recruiting caregivers, CNAs, home health aides, or similar positions.

-Previous experience leading or coaching recruitment team members.

-Familiarity with US employment practices, onboarding, and HR administration.

-Experience with Indeed, Apploi, Viventium, or similar recruitment and HR systems.

-Experience developing recruitment SOPs, performance scorecards, and process improvements.



What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days:

-Understand our current hiring process, caregiver requirements, and operational staffing needs.

-Take ownership of the active recruitment pipeline.

-Identify immediate opportunities to improve applicant quality and caregiver availability matching.

-Establish consistent recruitment tracking and reporting.



Within 60 days:

-Demonstrate measurable improvements in recruitment efficiency and candidate quality.

-Strengthen coordination between Recruitment and Scheduling.

-Implement practical improvements to candidate screening and hiring workflows.



Within 90 days:

-Demonstrate consistent ownership of recruitment outcomes and a reliable hiring pipeline.

-Establish repeatable recruitment processes that support workforce growth.

-Begin taking on additional HR responsibilities based on business priorities and demonstrated readiness.



Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

-Hands-on: Comfortable doing the actual recruitment work, not just supervising others.

-Accountable: Takes responsibility for hiring outcomes, not simply the number of applicants processed.

-Proactive: Identifies problems early and takes initiative to resolve them.

-Data-driven: Understands how to use recruitment metrics to improve performance.

-Organized: Can build repeatable processes and maintain reliable systems.

-Leadership-oriented: Has the experience and potential to eventually manage a broader HR and administrative function.



This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced recruiter who is ready to take greater ownership, build systems, and grow into an expanded HR leadership role.



How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume and answer the following questions: (Video submission of no more than 5 minutes)

1. Describe your experience managing end-to-end recruitment. What roles have you recruited for, and approximately how many hires have you handled per month?

2. What recruitment KPIs have you been responsible for, and how did you improve them?

3. How would you approach a situation where candidates are getting hired but their availability does not match the company's actual staffing requirements?

4. What recruitment platforms and ATS systems have you used?

5. Tell us about a recruitment process you improved. What was the problem, what did you change, and what results did you achieve?



Please include "Recruitment First" in the subject line of your application.



We look forward to connecting with professionals who are ready to take ownership of recruitment and grow with our organization.

title: Business Development & Sales Specialist
description:
Business Development & Sales Specialist| Remote Dance Studio Sales



If you’ve ever spotted a way to bring in customers and thought, “I’d love to be the one who runs with that,” you’ll have that opportunity here.



Your job is to figure out where our next students will come from and make the first move. You might get a local organization to introduce the studio to its families, start a conversation with a parent who’s looking for classes, or discover a referral source we’ve overlooked. The owner knows the studio and its students. You bring the outreach experience to turn that knowledge into a steady flow of interested families.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



- Generate new leads. This is your main responsibility. Choose promising outreach channels, build referral relationships, and start conversations. Track which efforts bring interested families to the studio so you know where to invest your time.

- Turn interest into enrollment. About 98% of our students are kids, so most of your conversations will be with parents. We offer adult classes too. Respond promptly to inquiries during your shifts, learn what each person is looking for, and recommend a class they’ll feel confident signing up for.

- Own the follow up. Use calls, texts, and
s to keep conversations moving. Keep the CRM current and give the owner a brief daily update on new leads, bookings, enrollments, and next steps.

- Support the studio with a weekly
 to leads, occasional social media content, and light VA tasks. Sales and outreach come first.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING



Previous sales experience is required, including experience finding your own prospects. We’ll introduce you to our classes and the families we serve. From there, you’ll d
 who to reach, what to say, and what to change when an approach gets few replies.



Strong phone skills matter here. You can put a parent at ease, ask a thoughtful question, listen to the answer, and confidently invite them to enroll. You’ll need C1 level or higher spoken and written English.



We value someone we can count on. When you tell a parent you’ll call on Thursday, you make the call. When an outreach idea shows promise, you take the next step without waiting for a reminder. Previous VA experience is preferred. CRM familiarity and an interest in dance are both welcome.



PAID TRIAL, BASE PAY, AND BONUSES



The role begins with a 2 week paid trial at 20 hours per week. You’ll receive $125 USD total for 40 hours. We’ll agree on your trial shifts in advance.



During the trial, we’ll assess your initiative, lead generation, sales ability, and reliability. We’ll look at the prospects you find independently, the conversations your outreach starts, which ones progress toward bookings or paid enrollments, and how consistently you follow through.



Candidates who demonstrate exceptional performance during the trial may transition to the regular 34-hour engagement ahead of schedule.



At the end of the trial, we’ll review the results together. If we both d
 to continue, you’ll move to 34 hours per week with a base salary of $450 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks through Wise.



You can earn performance bonuses on top of your base pay when your outreach consistently brings in multiple new paying students per month.



REGULAR SCHEDULE



All times are US Pacific Time.



Monday through Friday: 10 am to 2 pm and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a break from 2 pm to 4 pm.

Saturday and Sunday: 10 am to noon each day.



That’s 34 hours across 7 days. Both weekend shifts are required. We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. We’ll discuss and agree on any changes in advance.



HOW TO APPLY

title: 3D Character Animator – Children's YouTube Series | Ongoing Episode Production
description:
## About Us



BFF Fluffies is an Australian children's educational entertainment brand targeting children aged 0–4 years.



Our brand combines adorable, plush-style 3D animated characters, whimsical environments, educational storytelling, music and friendship-based adventures.



We are seeking an exceptionally talented, reliable and detail-oriented animation specialist to support the ongoing production of our original animated YouTube series.



Our objective is to establish a long-term, commercially sustainable production partnership and recruit a permanent, dedicated member of the BFF Fluffies production team.



## Established Brand and Creative Assets



BFF Fluffies is an established brand with a clearly defined visual identity and creative direction.



We already have:



- An approved brand logo.

- Four original, established 3D-style characters.

- Approved character reference sheets and strict character design rules.

- Established individual character voices.

- An established narrator voice.

- Approved environments, backgrounds and visual aesthetics.

- Existing approved animation footage.

- Established introductions and outros.

- Detailed production requirements and quality standards.

- Original storylines and educational content.



**This is not a character or brand redesign project.**



The successful candidate must be capable of accurately reproducing our established visual identity and matching or exceeding the animation quality demonstrated in our supplied reference videos.



Our characters, logo, backgrounds, voices and overall visual aesthetic must remain consistent with the approved references unless we expressly authorise a change.



## Animation Quality and Brand Consistency



The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to deliver:



- High-quality, polished, full-colour 3D character animation.

- Soft, plush-style character textures and detailed visual rendering.

- Accurate character anatomy, proportions, colours, facial features and distinguishing characteristics.

- Consistent character appearance across every scene and episode.

- Natural, expressive character movements and facial expressions.

- Accurate lip-sync using our established character voices.

- Consistent environments, lighting, scale and scene-to-scene continuity.

- Smooth camera movements and professional transitions.

- Clear, sharp footage in a minimum of 1080p resolution.

- Age-appropriate, engaging visual storytelling for young children.

- Professional audio integration, including supplied voices, narration, music and sound effects.



Unapproved changes to character designs, anatomy, colours, environments, logo or established voices are not acceptable.



The supplied visual references and approved animation footage will be the authoritative benchmark for production quality and brand consistency.



## Initial Paid Project and Permanent Employment Opportunity



This initial paid, full-length episode production trial forms part of our recruitment process, with the ultimate objective of hiring a permanent, dedicated animation production specialist for BFF Fluffies.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an integral member of our growing team, take ownership of ongoing animation production and grow alongside our brand.



Subject to successful completion of the initial trial, demonstrated quality, reliability, adherence to deadlines and commercially sustainable production costs, our intention is to offer an ongoing, permanent remote position, with part-time or full-time arrangements to be negotiated.



We intend to shortlist suitable candidates for a paid, fixed-price, full-length episode production trial.



The initial project will involve producing a complete animated children's entertainment episode of approximately 20–25 minutes.



We are not simply looking to commission a short animation clip. We want to assess the successful candidate's ability to manage and deliver a complete episode to a professional standard, within an agreed budget and timeframe.



Future projects may include:



- Full-length educational entertainment episodes.

- Short-form animated content.

- Educational songs and music videos.

- Sensory and calming videos.

- YouTube Shorts and promotional content.

- Seasonal and special-edition episodes.



## Production Workflow and Reusable Assets



We are open to conventional 3D animation, AI-assisted animation or a hybrid production workflow.



We are interested in the quality, consistency, reliability and commercial sustainability of the finished product rather than prescribing a particular software platform.



We would particularly welcome proposals involving reusable, fully rigged 3D character models, facial animation controls, reusable environments and animation libraries to improve production efficiency.



Any character models created must accurately replicate our existing approved character designs rather than reinterpret them.



The successful candidate should be capable of independently managing the technical production process from supplied creative instructions through to final delivery.



## What We Will Provide



For each episode, we will provide the relevant creative and production materials, including:



- Detailed episode concepts and educational objectives.

- Scripts and storylines.

- Scene-by-scene production instructions.

- Approved character reference sheets.

- Character-specific rules and requirements.

- Approved environment and background references.

- Existing animation footage and quality benchmarks.

- Established character voices and narrator voice references or recordings.

- Dialogue, narration and audio direction.

- Approved brand assets, introductions and outros.

- Creative direction and timely approval feedback.



We will retain creative direction and final approval while the successful candidate takes responsibility for technical execution, production management and quality control.



## Deadlines, Communication and Approval Process



Reliability, communication and adherence to deadlines are essential.



We require a production partner who can:



- Commit to realistic, agreed production deadlines.

- Provide a clear production schedule with defined milestones.

- Submit initial character and environment assets for approval before proceeding with animation, where new assets are required.

- Submit an initial representative animated sequence for quality and brand approval.

- Submit individual scenes or agreed batches of scenes for progressive review throughout production.

- Obtain approval at agreed milestones before proceeding with dependent production stages.

- Maintain an accurate production log and track scene approvals, revisions and outstanding requirements.

- Proactively identify potential production issues and communicate them before they affect deadlines or costs.

- Incorporate agreed feedback accurately and efficiently.

- Conduct thorough internal quality control before submitting footage for review.

- Deliver the completed episode by the agreed deadline.



We do not want to receive an entire completed episode only to discover that character designs, environments or other brand requirements have not been followed.



Progressive approvals are intended to maintain quality, minimise unnecessary rework and ensure the production remains on task, on brand, on budget and on schedule.



We are looking for someone who can work independently from detailed instructions without requiring constant supervision or repeated reminders regarding established character and brand rules.



## Required Skills and Experience



- Demonstrated experience in high-quality 3D character animation.

- Strong character modelling, rigging and animation capabilities, or an equivalent reliable production workflow.

- Experience creating expressive, stylised animated characters.

- Experience with facial animation and lip-sync.

- Environment creation, lighting, rendering and video editing.

- Strong attention to detail and visual continuity.

- Ability to accurately reproduce existing character designs.

- Experience managing complex animation projects and meeting deadlines.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Excellent communication and organisational skills.



Experience producing children's entertainment, animated YouTube episodes, preschool educational content or comparable stylised animation is highly desirable.



Experience with Blender, Autodesk Maya or equivalent professional animation software is welcomed.



## Compensation and Commercial Terms



The initial full-length episode trial will be paid at an agreed fixed price, with clearly defined deliverables, production milestones and payment schedules.



Ongoing compensation will be negotiated based on experience, demonstrated quality, production capacity and the agreed working arrangement.



All anticipated production costs must be disclosed and agreed before work commences, including software, rendering, AI generation or other third-party costs where applicable.



Any additional expenditure or changes to the agreed project scope must receive prior written approval.



Revisions required to correct deviations from the approved brief, character references or agreed quality standards must be included within the agreed project price. Additional creative changes requested outside the agreed scope can be separately negotiated.



## Intellectual Property and Confidentiality



We require appropriate commercial usage rights, intellectual property assignment for commissioned original assets and delivery of relevant editable source files.



All commissioned original character models, rigs, environments, animations and other agreed production assets must be available for ongoing use by Frank & Fans Pty Ltd.



Any third-party assets or licensing restrictions must be disclosed before production commences.



Confidentiality and protection of our original characters, voices, brand assets and unpublished content are essential.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio, including at least three examples of your most relevant 3D character animation work.

2. Details of your personal contribution to the supplied portfolio examples.

3. Examples of longer-form animation projects or complete episodes, where available.

4. Your recommended production approach for accurately replicating our established characters and visual style.

5. Your preferred animation software and production tools.

6. Whether you work independently or as part of a production team.

7. An indicative fixed-price quotation for creating four reusable, fully rigged character models, if required by your proposed workflow.

8. An indicative fixed-price quotation for producing a complete 20–25-minute animated episode.

9. Your estimated ongoing production cost per episode once reusable character models and environments have been established.

10. Your estimated production timeframe for the initial episode.

11. Your anticipated ongoing production capacity, including how many episodes you could realistically deliver per month.

12. Your proposed production milestones, approval process and included revisions.

13. Confirmation that editable source files and appropriate commercial and intellectual property rights can be provided.

14. Your earliest available commencement date.

15. Your expected monthly compensation for ongoing part-time or full-time work, including your available working hours.



Please identify any assumptions or additional information required to provide a more accurate quotation.



We understand that final pricing may require a detailed review of our supplied references and episode brief.



Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, with initial shortlisting commencing Monday, 30 November 2026.



We are looking for a creative, dependable and commercially minded production specialist who takes genuine pride in delivering exceptional animation and is excited by the opportunity to become a permanent member of our growing team.



If you believe you can match or exceed our established animation quality while maintaining strict brand consistency, we would love to hear from you.



**BFF Fluffies**



Little adventures. Big discoveries. Best friends forever.



Frank & Fans Pty Ltd | Australia

title: Business Development & Proposals Coordinator | B2B Sales, Research & Growth
description:
Company: Afrobees Group

Location: Remote, Philippines

Schedule: 20 hours per week, approximately four hours per weekday

Compensation: US$4.00 per hour plus 5% commission

Starting period: Paid 60-day part-time trial, followed by a full-time extension

Earliest start: Monday, November 30, 2026

Website: 



About Afrobees Group

Afrobees Group is an early-stage business development, investment facilitation, and market advisory firm based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. We help entrepreneurs, small businesses, investors, and institutions plan for growth, prepare for funding, and pursue opportunities across Canada and Africa.

Our services include business growth and transformation, market entry and expansion, investment readiness and strategic partnerships, grant research and proposal development, development project advisory, and diaspora business and project support.



Our initial growth focus is Black-owned small businesses in Canada and African diaspora entrepreneurs across North America. We also support African businesses and institutions, and help Canadian and international clients explore opportunities in African markets.



About the role

You’ll be our first business development hire, working directly with the founder. You’ll manage the day-to-day sales pipeline, follow up on inbound inquiries, research new opportunities, and help prepare proposals and client deliverables. You’ll also document the workflows that future team members will use.



We’re building the agency from an early stage and want to grow quickly as client demand develops. This role suits someone who can write a credible B2B follow-up, research a client’s business question, and keep a proposal moving toward a deadline. As we add team members, there’s a path toward Business Development Lead, with responsibility for onboarding, training, and coordinating others.



Key responsibilities

B2B sales and growth for Afrobees

1. Identify and qualify prospective clients, referral sources, and business partners. Research each prospect’s needs, write personalized outreach, and follow up consistently.

2. Review existing and new inquiries. Clarify what each prospect is trying to achieve, research the information or partnerships they’re seeking, and recommend a next step.

3. Manage leads in GoHighLevel. Keep contact records, pipeline stages, notes, and follow-up dates current. Book qualified discovery calls and brief the founder.

4. Help package our services, prepare scopes and proposals, and follow up through the client’s decision and payment.



Client research, business planning, and funding support

1. Research markets, competitors, customers, commercial opportunities, and potential partners for Afrobees and its clients.

2. Draft business plans, growth strategies, market-entry briefs, and practical recommendations for small businesses and diaspora-led ventures.

3. Identify relevant grants, financing programs, investors, and strategic partners. Verify eligibility, deadlines, and documentation requirements using reliable sources.

4. Help prepare grant applications, funding briefs, concept notes, and supporting documents. Coordinate missing information with clients and partners.



Institutional proposals and bids

1. Track relevant requests for proposals, expressions of interest, and procurement opportunities from NGOs, international organizations, and World Bank–funded projects.

2. Assess each opportunity for fit. Summarize the scope, eligibility, experience requirements, deadlines, and whether Afrobees would need a delivery partner.

3. For approved bids, maintain the submission checklist, gather team and partner inputs, draft proposal sections, and coordinate reviews ahead of the deadline.



Operations and team development

1. Maintain sales templates, proposal files, client intake checklists, and handover procedures. Keep deadlines and next actions visible so work can progress between founder check-ins.

2. Send a short weekly update covering leads, calls, proposals, and decisions needed.

3. As the team grows, help onboard and train coordinators, guide them through established workflows, and coordinate handovers.



What success looks like in the first 60 days

>First two weeks: Review existing inquiries, give every active lead a next action in GoHighLevel, and build an initial list of qualified prospects and referral partners.

>By day 30: Establish a regular outreach and follow-up routine, book qualified sales conversations, and produce a strong research brief or proposal draft the founder can review.

>By day 60: Show which outreach is generating replies and calls, what paid work you helped secure, and which opportunities are worth pursuing next. Document the sales and delivery procedures you’ve tested so a future coordinator can follow them.



Skills and experience

>Hands-on experience in B2B sales, business development, or lead generation, including qualification, follow-up, and helping move prospects toward a decision.

>Strong written and spoken English. You can write a clear client
, summarize a business opportunity, and explain your recommendation.

>Experience with at least one of the following: market research, business planning, grant applications, proposal writing, or procurement bids.

>Experience using a CRM to manage contacts, next actions, and deadlines. GoHighLevel experience is a plus.

>Strong research and organizational skills. You verify facts, cite sources, and flag missing information early.

>Ability to work independently in a startup, manage competing deadlines, and take ownership of agreed priorities.



Experience working with Canadian or North American small businesses, consulting firms, NGOs, or international development projects is welcome. 



Pay, schedule, and growth

>Base pay: US$4.00 per hour for 20 hours per week during the paid 60-day trial. US$320 per four-week period, plus commission.

>Commission: 5% of all professional fees Afrobees actually collects on engagements you help secure. Attribution and payout terms will be agreed in writing.

>Payment schedule: Choose twice monthly or once monthly, whichever you prefer.

>Working hours: Approximately four hours per weekday. Most work can be completed asynchronously (Employees have flexible working hours but must meet agreed deadlines and deliverables ) with agreed Calgary-time overlap for check-ins and client coordination.

>After the trial: We’ll review performance, client demand, and revenue to decide whether to move to full-time. A full-time offer would include an increased base salary and an enhanced commission plan, with terms agreed at the review. As the team expands, there’s a path to Business Development Lead.



How to apply

>Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line Afrobees Business Development & Proposals Coordinator. Please include:

Your résumé and a short introduction.

>One example of a B2B opportunity you helped move forward. Tell us what you personally did and what happened.

>One redacted or publicly shareable writing sample, such as a market research brief, business plan, grant application, or proposal section.

>The CRM tools you’ve used and what you managed in them.

>Your weekday availability in Philippine time, your earliest start date, and confirmation that the starting pay and schedule work for you.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a brief interview and a paid practical task involving a sample client inquiry and bid opportunity.

title: AI Automation Developer
description:
AI Automation Developer — n8n, Grok Bot & Photorealistic AI Image/Video Generation



Location: Philippines (Remote)

Job Type: Project-Based → Ongoing

Pay: Based on Experience



We produce high-protein meal-prep recipe videos and sell digital cookbooks.



We already have a fully built AI image and video generation automation using n8n, DigitalOcean, Airtable, Nano Banana, and Grok APIs, including batch processing and human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval checkpoints.



We need a hands-on developer to make our existing system more modular, improve visual quality, and automate content distribution for approximately 120 unique videos per month.



1. Update Our Existing Production Workflow — Modular AI Model Integration



Our image and video generation automation is ALREADY BUILT. We are NOT looking to rebuild it.



The primary objective is to make the existing workflow modular and flexible, allowing us to easily swap AI image and video models as better or more affordable models become available.



* Enable plug-and-play integration of different AI image and video generation APIs.

* Make model selection and generation parameters easily configurable, preferably through Airtable.

* Allow us to switch between AI providers without significant workflow modifications.

* Enable easy adjustments to image resolution (1K/2K), video resolution (720p/1080p), clip duration, and other supported parameters.

* Allow different models and quality settings for opening hooks versus remaining video clips.

* Preserve existing batch processing, HITL approval checkpoints, Airtable integrations, and workflow functionality.

* Maintain API cost tracking, error handling, retries, and generation reliability.

* Document how to add or replace models so future changes require minimal development work.



The goal is a future-proof, modular system that can adapt quickly to advancements in AI image and video generation without repeatedly paying for major development work.



2. Photorealistic Visual AI + Expert Prompting (HIGH PRIORITY)



* Create AI cooking images and videos that look virtually indistinguishable from professionally filmed footage, with realistic hands, utensils, chopping, stirring, pouring, steam, sauces, melted cheese, food textures, and natural physics.

* Develop and optimize image prompts, motion prompts, camera directions, lighting, and composition.

* Maintain consistent kitchens, ingredients, plating, and visual styles across generated clips.

* Identify and correct flickering, morphing, unnatural motion, inconsistent objects, and other AI artifacts.

* Benchmark AI models for photorealism, reliability, generation speed, and cost through A/B testing.

* Strong preference: Demonstrated experience with Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, Grok Imagine, Kling, Seedance, WAN, or comparable advanced image/video models, supported by a strong portfolio.



When submitting your application, include the word “crystals” somewhere in your application title so we can properly identify your submission during portfolio reviews.



3. Build a Centralized Grok Bot Publishing Hub



Create one centralized system to generate platform-specific captions, titles, hashtags, thumbnails, and Shopify/cookbook links, then schedule and distribute approved content through official APIs wherever supported.



Our eight target platforms:



1. Instagram Reels

2.
 Reels

3. TikTok

4. YouTube Shorts

5. Pinterest

6. Threads

7. X 
)

8. Reddit



Responsibilities:



* Connect our existing content production system to Grok Bot.

* Manage an Airtable publishing queue with planned, approved, scheduled, published, and failed statuses.

* Monitor publishing results, automatically retry eligible failures, and prevent duplicate posts.

* Evaluate API approvals, rate limits, thumbnail capabilities, platform restrictions, and costs.

* Prioritize direct platform API integrations and Grok Bot routines over paid third-party schedulers where practical.



4. Automate More of the End-to-End Process



Our goal is a streamlined production and publishing system:



Recipe/Prompt → AI Images → AI Video Clips → Automated Compilation → Captions/Covers → Approval → Grok Bot → Eight Platforms



Further reduce manual VA work through:



* Automated batch generation and monitoring.

* Identifying and regenerating defective clips.

* Automated video compilation using FFmpeg or similar tools.

* File organization and production management.

* AI-assisted visual quality checks.

* Production, publishing, and API cost dashboards.



Build upon our existing infrastructure rather than unnecessarily recreating functionality.



Technical Requirements



Required:



* Advanced n8n workflow development and modular workflow architecture.

* REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth.

* JavaScript and/or Python.

* Airtable API integrations.

* DigitalOcean, Linux, and self-hosted infrastructure.

* API debugging, authentication, rate limits, logging, and troubleshooting.

* Experience safely modifying existing production workflows.



Highly Preferred:



* Advanced photorealistic AI image/video generation and prompt engineering.

* Extensive knowledge of current AI visual models and their API capabilities.

* Grok Bot, AI agents, and automated routines.

* Social publishing APIs (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc.).

* FFmpeg and automated video processing.

* Docker, Git/GitHub, Shopify integrations, and analytics.



What Success Looks Like



* A modular AI production system with easily interchangeable image and video models.

* More realistic, professional-quality AI cooking videos.

* Lower AI generation costs without compromising visual quality.

* Centralized publishing across eight platforms.

* Significantly reduced manual production work.

* Secure, documented, maintainable automation workflows, credentials, and infrastructure under company ownership.



We value technical expertise, visual creativity, independent problem-solving, cost optimization, and clear communication.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Portfolio: Two real automation projects, including at least one AI/API integration.

2. Loom Video: A 2–5 minute walkthrough of an automation you personally built.

3. AI Visual Samples: Your best photorealistic AI images/videos, including models used and a brief explanation of your prompting techniques.

4. Technical Approach: Briefly explain how you would make an existing n8n workflow modular for easy AI model swapping and approach centralized publishing to eight platforms.

5. Compensation & Availability: Your hourly/project rate, weekly availability, and interest in ongoing work.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical test.



Important: This is a technical developer and visual AI production role, not a general VA or manual social media posting position. Generic applications without evidence of hands-on experience will not be prioritized.

title: Seeking a Co-Founder (Cold Calling & Closing): Local SEO & Google Leads for Home Service Companies
description:
We are looking for a co-founder to build and grow a small SEO and lead generation business with us. This is not a typical job. You are coming in as a co-founder, building something of your own, and you earn a share of every client you bring in, every month, for as long as they stay.



What the business does

We help local home service companies get more customers from Google, Bing, ChatGPT and Gemini. Our work:

- Semantic SEO: a niche part of SEO that helps a local company show up on Google, Bing, ChatGPT and Gemini.

- Reputation management: more and better Google reviews.

- A website and Google presence that turns searches into calls and quote requests.



We focus mainly on shower glass and shower door companies, and we have also worked with an insurance company and a fencing company. The business already has paying monthly clients, and the delivery side (the SEO and site work) is already built and running. What it needs now is a partner who can sell it and grow it.



This is a cold calling role

Most of your day is on the phone. We give you the lead lists: shower glass companies across the US, with owner names and phone numbers. Our team also reaches out by
 and LinkedIn and passes any warm replies to you. You cold call the owners, book demos, run the demos on Zoom, and close.



What you will do

- Cold call shower glass company owners across the US every day. This is the main part of the job.

- Turn those calls into demo calls on Zoom, showing owners real results from current clients.

- Close new clients and get them signed up.

- Follow up with the warm leads our team sends you.

- Be the person the owner trusts: welcome them, answer their questions, and check in with them so they stay.

- Tell us what you hear on calls so we keep improving the offer, the scripts and the follow-up.



We train you on the product, the results we get, and how we deliver.



Who we are looking for

- 3+ years of cold calling and closing US small business owners. You are comfortable making a lot of calls every day.

- Experience selling websites, SEO, digital marketing, CRM or SaaS on a monthly subscription is a big plus.

- You run demos on Zoom with confidence and are comfortable asking for the sale.

- You think like an owner. You have built a sales process, started something, or worked at an early stage startup.

- You build relationships that last. Clients stay with you.

- Strong spoken and written English. Available for calls in US business hours.

- Self-driven, coachable, and you track your own numbers.



How you are paid

Our service is $497 a month per client. For every client you bring in, you keep $200 a month, every month, for as long as that client stays with us. Five clients means $1,000 a month to you, ten clients means $2,000 a month, and it keeps building.



To help you get started while you build your first clients, we pay up to $200 a month base during the ramp up.



Please read this part carefully. You are starting a business, and that takes time and responsibility. Your income grows with the clients you sign. If you need a full salary right away, this is not the right fit, and that is okay. If you want to build something that is yours and grows every month, we want to talk to you.



How to apply

1. Start your message with the word "Glass" so we know you read this.

2. In 3 to 5 sentences, tell us about your cold calling: what you sold, who you called, how many calls a day, and your results (demos booked, close rate, deals per month).

3. Send a 1 to 2 minute voice note or video: cold call a shower door company owner as if it were a real call, from your opener to booking the demo.

4. Have you ever started a business or side project of your own? Tell us about it.

title: KDP Book Production Specialist: Formatting, AI Tools & Quality Control
description:
We are a British publishing company looking for a careful, reliable person to research, create and produce AI-assisted books for Amazon KDP.



You will take books from research to upload-ready files: researching topics, writing and editing with AI tools, proofreading, formatting, quality control, images, covers and A+ Content. This is a hands-on production role. It needs someone who reads instructions closely, keeps track of their own tasks and fixes mistakes without being reminded.



TO SHOW YOU HAVE READ THIS POST, START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "KDP READY".



Responsibilities

- Research book topics, competitors and keywords

- Write and edit books using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini), following our prompts and SOPs

- Manually proofread the full text of each book, up to 30,000 words at times, checking grammar, facts, repeated or missing content and consistency

- Format interiors for paperback, hardcover and eBook (Atticus, Word, Canva)

- Check margins, gutters, bleed, trim size and page count against KDP requirements

- Create interior images and covers with AI tools and Canva

- Build A+ Content and prepare KDP uploads and metadata

- Keep a task list, acknowledge every request and post daily status updates

- Spot problems before publication and suggest fixes



Requirements

- Excellent written English and clear spoken English (we use video calls)

- Very strong attention to detail, with the patience to proofread long texts carefully

- Hands-on formatting experience with Atticus, Word or similar tools

- Comfortable with AI tools, including AI image generation

- Reads instructions carefully, asks when unsure, and does not repeat the same mistake

- Works independently, takes constructive feedback well and takes ownership of errors

- Hours: 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday (currently 5pm to 1am Philippines time), camera on for calls

- Reliable internet and power backup



KDP experience is an advantage but not essential. Strong formatting and attention to detail matter most.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short, paid skills test before any offer.



HOW TO APPLY: Answer every question below in your OWN words. Short, specific answers are better than polished ones. Applications that look copied from ChatGPT or other AI tools will be rejected.



Questions

1. Start with "KDP READY". Where are you located, and are you currently working for another employer or client?



2. Rate yourself from 1 (beginner) to 5 (expert) and say how many years or books you have used each tool for. Write "never used" if that applies.

   - Microsoft Word

   - Canva

   - Atticus

   - Affinity Publisher or Adobe InDesign

   - Kindle Create or Draft2Digital

   - Grammarly or other proofreading tools

   - Any other formatting or design tools



3. Which AI tools do you use right now? For each one, tell us your current plan (free or paid, for example "ChatGPT Plus $20 a month" or "Gemini free") and what you use it for.



4. Have you written or helped write a book or long document with AI, chapter by chapter? Describe your process and how you checked the facts.



5. AI images: which tools have you used, and how do you keep characters and style consistent across a whole book? Share links to examples.



6. Tell us about a real mistake you made at work. What happened, and what did you change afterwards?



7. Your manager says on Tuesday, "Adjust the margins, it's not urgent." On Friday they ask you to check your task list for anything missing. What do you do, and why?



8. List the five checks you would run before publishing a 30,000-word book, in order, and say why the first one is most important.



Please provide

- Resume/CV: open link (no access request needed)

- Portfolio: open link to formatted interiors, covers, Canva work or AI images

- A 60 to 90 second video or voice message (Google Drive, Loom or similar link): introduce yourself and describe one book you worked on



Only applications that answer all questions and include accessible links and the video or voice message will be considered.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to build a career in publishing.
