title: USA CPA (Certified Public Accountant) - Financial Specialist
description:
Position Summary



ASun Star is seeking an experienced Finance Specialist with an active U.S. CPA license to strengthen financial oversight, ensure accurate financial reporting, and support responsible organizational growth. This position requires demonstrated experience auditing financial statements and payroll, identifying discrepancies, and improving financial controls.



The Finance Specialist will work closely with executive leadership, operations, human resources, and billing to oversee financial accuracy across ASun Star’s programs and locations. The ideal candidate is analytical, thorough, and comfortable investigating transactions, resolving accounting issues, and presenting clear findings and recommendations. Experience with US tax law a plus. 



Essential Responsibilities



Financial Accounting and Reporting

- Maintain and review the general ledger, account reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting documentation.

- Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow reports.

- Manage month-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely, accurate reporting.

- Review bank and credit card transactions, expense classifications, and allocations across entities, programs, departments, and locations.

- Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, outstanding balances, and cash flow.

- Develop budgets, forecasts, and variance reports; explain significant differences and recommend corrective actions.

Financial Auditing and Internal Controls

- Conduct internal financial reviews and audits to verify the accuracy, completeness, and support for financial transactions.

- Examine financial statements, bank records, invoices, expense reports, and other supporting records to identify discrepancies, duplicate payments, unsupported expenses, or unusual activity.

- Assess internal controls, approval procedures, and segregation of duties; recommend practical improvements.

- Document findings, communicate concerns promptly, and track corrective actions through resolution.

- Coordinate with external auditors, tax professionals, and other authorized reviewers; prepare schedules and supporting documentation.

- Maintain organized financial records and audit trails.

Payroll Review and Auditing

- Audit payroll for accuracy, including employee compensation, hours worked, overtime, paid leave, deductions, benefits, reimbursements, and employer contributions.

- Reconcile payroll registers to timekeeping records, approved compensation, bank activity, and general ledger accounts.

- Verify that new hires, terminations, pay changes, and payroll adjustments are properly authorized and accurately processed.

- Review payroll tax filings and payments with the payroll provider and resolve discrepancies.

- Confirm accurate allocation of payroll expenses across programs, departments, funding sources, and locations.

- Investigate payroll errors, duplicate payments, unauthorized changes, and timekeeping inconsistencies.

- Collaborate with HR and operations to resolve payroll concerns and improve payroll procedures.

Organizational Support and Compliance

- Support financial reporting requirements associated with contracts, grants, insurance reimbursements, and other funding arrangements.

- Coordinate tax preparation and required financial filings with external professionals.

- Develop and update accounting, expense reimbursement, purchasing, and payroll procedures.

- Provide leadership with clear financial summaries, emerging concerns, and actionable recommendations.

- Protect confidential employee, organizational, and financial information.



Required Qualifications

- Active CPA license issued by a U.S. state or jurisdiction, in good standing.

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a closely related field.

- At least five years of progressively responsible accounting or finance experience.

- Demonstrated experience auditing financial statements, accounting records, and payroll.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), financial reporting, reconciliations, and internal controls.

- Working knowledge of U.S. payroll processes, payroll taxes, and multistate payroll considerations.

- Experience with accounting software, payroll platforms, and timekeeping systems.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to analyze large transaction datasets.

- Ability to independently investigate discrepancies, document conclusions, and communicate findings clearly.

- Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in behavioral health, healthcare, or human services organizations.

- Experience with organizations operating across multiple programs, locations, or legal entities.

- Familiarity with New Jersey and Pennsylvania payroll and financial operations.

- Experience reviewing Medicaid-funded program revenue, insurance payments, grants, or government contracts.

- Experience with QuickBooks, third-party payroll providers, and timekeeping platforms such as Hubstaff.

- Public accounting or external audit experience.

Performance Expectations



Success in this role includes accurate and timely financial reporting, completed account and payroll reconciliations, prompt identification and resolution of discrepancies, well-supported expense allocations, and documented improvements to financial controls.



About ASun Star



ASun Star provides behavioral health, developmental, and community-based services to children, adults, and families. Guided by our mission, “Helping People, Changing Lives!!”, we are committed to compassionate services, operational accountability, and responsible stewardship of the resources that support our communities.

title: JerseyBird Long Form Documentary Editor
description:
JerseyBird is one of the most followed teamwear brands in the world. We design custom kits for clubs and schools, and we make JerseyBird on Tour, a documentary series on YouTube: 50 states, 50 stops, 50 stories. In each episode we travel to a team we made kits for and tell the story of the program, the people and the town.



Here is episode one: 



That episode is where we started, not where we are going. We love the animations in it and we want more of that. The pacing and polish are what we believe can be improved, and the next episodes have to be a clear level above it.



We are hiring one long-form documentary editor to own these episodes from raw footage to the final upload-ready file. This is not a role for a short-form editor. We need two things in one person:



1. A real filmmaker. You understand story, pacing, tension and emotion, and you have the hard skills to finish a film: edit, color, sound.



2. AI forward. The animations in episode one were built with an AI-assisted After Effects workflow. You already use AI tools in your motion graphics and editing, and you keep finding new ones. AI makes your work faster and better. It does not replace your taste.



THE WORK



- One episode a month, 30 to 60 minutes each, plus other JerseyBird documentaries as the show grows.



- You receive organized footage, a full script with clip IDs and timestamps, transcripts of every clip, recorded voiceover and reference material.



- You deliver the finished episode. That means all of it:

  - Story edit: pacing, structure, tension, emotion. The script is the backbone, and you make it work on screen.

  - Motion graphics and animation: title cards, name lower thirds, location tags, animated travel maps, player cards and squad screens, on-screen breakdowns with circles and arrows.

  - Captions in one consistent style from start to finish.

  - Color correction and grade.

  - Sound design, music edit and final mix.



- Every graphic is built new for each episode. Nothing is lifted from an old video.



PAY

- $30 USD per finished minute of the approved final episode. A 40 minute episode pays $1,200.

- Two rounds of revisions are included in the rate.

- Paid per episode on approval.

- A retention bonus on top of the rate when an episode beats our audience retention target on YouTube.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 long-form documentaries (15 minutes or longer) that you edited yourself.

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. This is required. You deliver the final file and the full project with organized media.

- Strong motion graphics and animation skills, with AI tools as part of how you work. You build the graphics yourself.

- Color and audio finishing skills.

- A computer and internet connection that can handle large 4K projects.

- Clear written English. You read a detailed script and follow it, and you speak up when something on the page does not work on screen.

- You hit deadlines and you check your own work. No black frames, no missing lower thirds, no unfinished endings in a cut you send us.

- Sports documentary experience is a plus. A love of soccer is a bigger one.



HOW TO APPLY

Put the words "Fifty stops" in the subject line so we know you read this. Then send:

1. Links to 2 or 3 long-form documentaries (15 minutes or longer) you edited.

2. For each one, exactly what you did yourself: edit, graphics, color, sound. If someone else did part of it, say so.

3. Watch episode one and tell us two things you would change to take it up a level.

4. The AI tools you use today and one example of work you made with them (a link or a short clip).

5. Your usual turnaround for a 30 minute documentary.



The strongest applicants get a paid test: a 2 to 3 minute sequence cut from our real footage, with graphics. The hire is made from that test.



Applications without long-form samples will not be read.

title: : Senior Local SEO Strategist (Google Maps & Search) – Full Time, Remote
description:
IL Webdesign is a website development and marketing agency serving medical spas, wellness clinics, telehealth practices, and local service businesses. We build and manage WordPress websites and run SEO for clients who count on us to bring in real patients and customers.



**About the Role**

We're looking for a dedicated, senior-level SEO Strategist who truly understands local search. You'll take ownership of client accounts, including clients who follow SEO best practices but still aren't ranking. Your job is to find out why, build a clear plan to fix it, and work with our team to put that plan in place.



This role is for someone who digs into the research, thinks critically, and brings ideas to the table, not someone who just checks boxes.



**What You'll Do**



- Learn each client's business inside and out: their website, Google Business Profile, services, service area, and competitors

- Research the keywords real patients and customers actually search

- Check rankings on Google Maps and Google Search each month and report where each client stands

- Diagnose why a client isn't ranking or is dropping, including technical, content, Google Business Profile, review, link, and competitor issues

- Build clear 90-day action plans and walk our team through them

- Optimize Google Business Profiles to improve Google Maps (Local 3-Pack) rankings

- Guide on-page SEO, location pages, internal linking, and schema

- Stay current on SEO changes, including Google AI Overviews, and suggest new ways to help our clients grow



**What We're Looking For**

- Fluent in English (Speaking & Reading)

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a strong focus on local SEO

- Proven results moving clients into the Google Maps top 3 and onto page 1 of Google Search (please share examples)

- Deep knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization

- Strong research skills. You use AI tools to work faster but never as a replacement for your own research and judgment

- Experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, or Local Falcon

- Clear written English and the ability to explain problems and plans simply

- Self-motivated, organized, and proactive. You spot problems before we ask

- WordPress experience is a strong plus



**What We Don't Want**



- Ranking "guarantees"

- Spammy shortcuts like link wheels, mass indexing tools, or auto-generated content

- Generic audits that aren't specific to the client



**How to Apply**

Serious applicants only. Please send:



- Your resume

- A short note (3 to 5 sentences) about a local client you helped rank, what was holding them back, and what you did to fix it. Screenshots or results are a plus if you can share them.



Applications without the note will not be reviewed.

title: Freight Dispatcher — U.S. Trucking (Experience Required, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
HOW TO APPLY: Please read before applying.

To apply, complete BOTH steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed.

Step 1—Send your resume and answer in your own words: Which carriers or brokerages have you dispatched for, and how many trucks?

Step 2—Record a Loom video (3 minutes maximum).

Record yourself as if you are on the phone with one of our drivers. He has arrived at a rail facility to pick up a load. The kiosk says there is no waybill for his load, so he cannot get in the gate. He has been waiting 40 minutes, and he is frustrated.

Talk through how you would handle that call and what you would do next.

Do not script it. We want to hear how you actually think.

Include your Loom link with your application.

About us

WH Trucking is a U.S.-based asset carrier operating out of Georgia. We run dedicated contract freight, intermodal/rail moves, and spot loads. We are a small team that moves fast, and you will work directly with the owner.

We are hiring four dispatchers to build out 24/7 coverage. This is a long-term position with room to grow as we add trucks.

A note on the schedule: our night shift runs from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM U.S. Eastern, which is approximately 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine time. If you are assigned nights, you will be working normal daytime hours locally.

What you'll do:

1.	Coordinate daily load assignments and driver schedules.

2.	Communicate with drivers throughout your shift on pickups, deliveries, and delays.

3.	Manage a dedicated contract account with recurring weekly loads.

4.	Handle rail/intermodal pickups and in-gate coordination.

5.	Track loads from pickup through delivery; flag problems before they escalate.

6.	Collect and file BOLs, PODs, and rate confirmations.

7.	Maintain dispatch trackers and operational spreadsheets

8.	Escalate facility, appointment, and detention issues

9.	Support spot load bidding and rate research.

10.	Hand off cleanly to the incoming dispatcher at shift change.



Required

1.	*** A MUST: Proficient in Google Workspace (Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Docs) *** An assessment will be given; please do not apply if you’re not proficient in this area.

2.	Prior U.S. freight dispatching experience. This is not negotiable. In your application, list the carriers or brokerages you dispatched for, along with the fleet size.

3.	Strong written and spoken English skills; you will speak with U.S. drivers and facility staff every shift.

4.	Confident on the phone, including with frustrated drivers

5.	Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection and a plan for power outages

6.	Quiet, dedicated workspace

7.	Self-starter who solves problems rather than forwarding them

8.	Nice to have—we will train.

9.	Amazon Relay experience

10.	Intermodal/rail experience (CSX, BNSF)

11.	Any TMS experience

12.	FMCSA compliance familiarity

13.	Small-fleet dispatch experience (as opposed to large carrier)



Availability requirements

This is a 12-hour shift position on a rotating schedule averaging 42 hours per week, with every other weekend off. Dispatch is a live-coverage role. Trucks, drivers, and facilities do not wait, and no one else can cover your desk while you are away from it. 

This position requires:

1.	Full availability for your entire 12-hour shift, without interruption

2.	A dedicated workspace separate from household activity

3.	Reliable internet plus a backup connection and a power outage plan

4.	No other concurrent job or client work during your shift

5.	Consistent attendance; coverage gaps directly affect our customer accounts.

6.	Willingness to work either day or night rotation as assigned



Please be honest with yourself about this before applying. If your current situation does not allow you to be at your desk and responsive for a full 12-hour block, this role will not be a good fit, and we would rather you apply for something that better suits your schedule.

HOW TO APPLY

To apply, complete BOTH steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed.

Step 1—Send your resume and answer in your own words: Which carriers or brokerages have you dispatched for, and how many trucks?

Step 2—Record a Loom video (3 minutes maximum).

Record yourself as if you are on the phone with one of our drivers. He has arrived at a rail facility to pick up a load. The kiosk says there is no waybill for his load, so he cannot get in the gate. He has been waiting 40 minutes, and he is frustrated.

Talk through how you would handle that call and what you would do next.

Do not script it. We want to hear how you actually think.

Include your Loom link with your application.

title: HR Manager - USA Payroll and Dept of Labor Experience
description:
Position Summary



ASun Star is seeking an experienced Human Resources Manager to oversee HR operations across its behavioral health, developmental, and community-based programs. This position manages recruitment, employee relations, onboarding, performance management, benefits administration, personnel records, and payroll coordination.



Hands-on experience with U.S. payroll and federal and state Department of Labor requirements is required. The ideal candidate can resolve payroll and employee concerns, maintain accurate records, guide managers, and build consistent HR practices across multiple locations. Experience supporting employees in New Jersey and Pennsylvania is strongly preferred.



Essential Responsibilities



Human Resources Management

- Manage daily HR operations and serve as a primary resource for employees and supervisors.

- Develop, implement, and maintain employee handbooks, HR policies, and operating procedures.

- Maintain accurate, confidential personnel records and track required employee documentation.

- Partner with leadership on workforce planning, staffing needs, employee retention, and organizational structure.

- Prepare HR reports covering staffing, turnover, attendance, vacancies, and outstanding compliance requirements.



U.S. Payroll and Timekeeping

- Manage or coordinate U.S. payroll processing with finance and the payroll provider.

- Review timesheets, pay rates, overtime, paid leave, deductions, benefits, reimbursements, and payroll adjustments before submission.

- Verify that new hires, terminations, compensation changes, and employee information are accurately entered and properly approved.

- Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies, missing hours, timekeeping concerns, and employee pay inquiries.

- Reconcile payroll records with approved compensation and timekeeping documentation.

- Coordinate payroll tax, withholding, and reporting matters with finance and the payroll provider.

- Monitor timekeeping practices and train supervisors on reviewing and approving employee hours.

- Maintain payroll documentation and support internal and external payroll audits.

Department of Labor Compliance

- Monitor HR and payroll practices for alignment with applicable federal and state labor requirements.

- Review wage and hour practices, including overtime, minimum wage, timekeeping, deductions, and record retention.

- Coordinate reviews of employee classifications, including exempt/nonexempt status and employee/independent contractor arrangements, with leadership and legal counsel as needed.

- Administer applicable leave requirements and coordinate accommodation requests.

- Maintain required workplace notices and employee communications.

- Coordinate responses to Department of Labor inquiries, audits, investigations, wage claims, and requests for records.

- Gather supporting documentation, track response deadlines, and implement approved corrective actions.

- Keep leadership informed of labor requirement changes that affect organizational practices.



Recruitment and Onboarding

- Manage recruitment, candidate screening, interview coordination, references, and employment offers.

- Coordinate required background checks, clearances, employment eligibility verification, and professional credential verification.

- Ensure employees complete onboarding, required training, policy acknowledgments, and program-specific documentation.

- Track professional licenses, certifications, clearances, and renewal deadlines.

- Collaborate with program leaders to maintain staffing readiness.

Employee Relations and Performance Management

- Address employee questions, workplace concerns, attendance issues, and interpersonal conflicts promptly and professionally.

- Conduct fair, documented workplace investigations and coordinate appropriate follow-up.

- Guide supervisors on performance expectations, coaching, evaluations, corrective action, and documentation.

- Coordinate employee separations, exit interviews, final payroll information, and return of organizational property.

- Promote a respectful, inclusive workplace consistent with ASun Star’s mission and values.

Benefits, Leave, and Staff Development

- Coordinate benefits enrollment, employee changes, and communication with benefits providers.

- Manage leave requests and related documentation while protecting confidential information.

- Coordinate required employee training and supervisor development.

- Support employee engagement, recognition, and retention initiatives.



Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

- Minimum of five years of progressive HR experience, including at least two years managing HR functions or staff.

- Demonstrated hands-on experience processing or overseeing U.S. payroll.

- Demonstrated experience applying federal and state Department of Labor requirements, including wage and hour rules, overtime, employee classification, and payroll recordkeeping.

- Experience preparing documentation for labor audits, investigations, wage claims, or similar compliance reviews.

- Experience handling employee relations, workplace investigations, performance management, and confidential records.

- Proficiency with HR information systems, payroll platforms, timekeeping systems, and Microsoft Office.

- Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate clearly with employees and leadership.

- Ability to independently identify concerns, recommend solutions, and follow issues through resolution.



Preferred Qualifications

- SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.

- HR and payroll experience in New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

- Experience in behavioral health, healthcare, human services, or another regulated service environment.

- Experience supporting multiple programs and locations.

- Direct experience coordinating responses to Department of Labor audits or investigations.

- Familiarity with clinical credential tracking, required clearances, and healthcare workforce requirements.

- Experience with Hubstaff or comparable timekeeping systems.

Performance Expectations



Success in this role includes accurate and timely payroll coordination, complete personnel files, timely onboarding and credential renewals, consistent handling of employee concerns, and documented follow-through on HR and labor compliance matters.



About ASun Star



ASun Star supports children, adults, and families through behavioral health, developmental, and community-based services. Guided by our mission, “Helping People, Changing Lives!!”, we seek professionals who bring compassion, accountability, and professionalism to their work.

title: Graphic Designer – Product Mock-ups, Branding & Print Design
description:
**Company:** Fridgy Australia  

**Location:** Philippines – Remote / Work from Home  

**Employment:** Full-time, long-term opportunity  

**Working Hours:** Monday to Friday, 8 am–4 pm Philippine time  

**Salary:** AUD $1000, depending on experience and demonstrated ability



## About Fridgy



Fridgy is a rapidly growing, Australian-owned premium insulated drinkware and cooler brand based in Perth, Western Australia.



Born in the Pilbara, Fridgy designs and develops high-quality products engineered for the Australian lifestyle. Our product range includes insulated drink bottles, tumblers, can coolers, soft coolers and lifestyle accessories.



We work with major retailers, national corporate organisations, professional sporting teams and businesses across Australia, while continuing to expand internationally.



We are looking for a talented, experienced and highly motivated graphic designer to become a long-term member of our growing team.



## About the Role



You will work directly with our Australian team and be responsible for producing high-quality graphic design material across our corporate, retail and marketing divisions.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are looking for a skilled graphic designer with strong technical abilities, creative flair and exceptional attention to detail.



## Key Responsibilities



### Product Mock-ups and Corporate Branding



- Create realistic co-branded product mock-ups using customer logos and Fridgy product imagery.

- Produce realistic visual representations of laser-engraved and colour-printed logos on our products.

- Convert low-resolution logos into clean, accurate vector artwork.

- Manually recreate customer artwork where automated vector conversion is insufficient.

- Prepare production-ready artwork for laser engraving and UV printing.

- Develop reusable product mock-up templates across our product range and colours.

- Deliver customer mock-ups accurately and within short turnaround times.



### Graphic Design and Marketing



- Design professional product catalogues, brochures, pamphlets and flyers.

- Create corporate sales presentations and personalised customer proposals.

- Design product specification sheets and promotional material.

- Develop retail point-of-sale graphics and display signage.

- Create website banners, product imagery and digital marketing assets.

- Assist with social media graphics when required.

- Maintain a consistent, premium brand identity across all design work.



### Packaging and Product Development



- Design and update retail product packaging.

- Work with existing packaging dielines and prepare print-ready artwork.

- Create product feature illustrations and technical graphics.

- Assist with visual concepts for new product launches.

- Liaise with our Australian team regarding artwork and production requirements.



## Essential Skills and Experience



- Minimum three years of professional graphic design experience, preferably five years or more.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop.

- Strong proficiency in Adobe InDesign.

- Excellent vector drawing and logo recreation skills.

- Experience creating realistic physical product mock-ups.

- Strong understanding of typography, colour, layout and visual hierarchy.

- Understanding of print production, CMYK, bleed, resolution and packaging dielines.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational and file management skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.

- Exceptional attention to detail.



## Highly Desirable Skills



- Experience using CorelDRAW.

- Experience preparing artwork for laser engraving or UV printing.

- Previous experience in promotional merchandise, drinkware, packaging or consumer products.

- Experience working with Australian or international brands.

- Experience with Shopify product imagery.

- Experience with 3D product rendering software such as Blender, KeyShot or Adobe Substance 3D.



## What We Offer



- Competitive remuneration based on experience and ability.

- Stable, full-time, long-term work.

- Direct communication with our Australian management and sales team.

- Australian business hours with no overnight shifts.

- Licensed Adobe Creative Cloud software.

- Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

- Salary growth based on performance and contribution to the business.

- The opportunity to become an integral part of a growing international consumer brand.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your CV or résumé.

2. A link to your graphic design portfolio.

3. Examples of realistic product mock-ups you have personally created.

4. Examples of catalogues, brochures or packaging you have designed.

5. Examples of vector artwork or logo recreation.

6. Details of your experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and CorelDRAW.

7. Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

8. Details of your computer equipment and internet connection.

9. Your availability to commence work.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to participate in a video interview and complete a paid practical design assessment.



Please include **FRIDGY DESIGN 2026** in the subject line of your application so we know you have read the full job description.



To learn more about our brand and products, visit our website at 
 or 
 look forward to welcoming a talented and passionate graphic designer to the Fridgy team.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About Us

We are a Los Angeles property management company with roughly 170 residential properties

and about thirty owners. Our accounting team keeps payables, receipts, reconciliations, and owner reporting accurate

and on time — all in AppFolio. Owners make decisions from the numbers we produce, so clean books are not a nice-to-

have.



The Role

You own the books. Day-to-day payables and receivables, monthly reconciliations across bank, loan and

credit card accounts, month-end close, journal entries, and the financial reports our owners and accountant

rely on. This is not data entry with a close attached — we want someone who can tell us why a number

moved, not just that it did.



What You'll Do

General accounting and bookkeeping

● Record daily transactions and maintain an accurate general ledger in AppFolio.

● Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjustments.

● Clean up miscategorized or historical transactions to restore reliable books.



Accounts payable and receivable

● Process vendor bills, verify approvals and schedule vendor payments.

● Prepare property owner invoices and progress billing, and follow up on collections.

● Maintain AP and AR aging reports and resolve discrepancies with vendors and clients.



Reconciliations and month-end close

● Reconcile bank, loan and corporate credit card accounts monthly.

● Run the month-end close checklist and deliver closing entries on schedule.

● Prepare P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports for management review.

● Perform P&L variance analysis and explain significant movements in plain English.



Payroll and billing

● Process payroll and reconcile payroll liabilities.

● Manage billing cycles, including job-based and project billing.



Insurance accounting

● Record insurance policies as prepaid assets and maintain amortization schedules.

● Track policy renewals and reconcile insurance-related accounts.



Systems and data

● Support AppFolio migrations (for example, Desktop to Online) and validate converted financial data.

● Keep data consistent across AppFolio and other applications.



Process improvement and controls

● Write and update SOPs for recurring accounting tasks.

● Recommend and apply internal controls that reduce errors and fraud risk.

● Improve finance workflows to shorten close time and reduce manual work.

Throughout

● Raise what does not reconcile. A number that will not tie out gets escalated with what you found — never

adjusted to fit.





Qualifications

● Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance or a related field.

● Then EITHER: 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, including 2+ years supporting U.S.-based

companies —

● OR: Philippine CPA licensure (PRC-registered, CPALE passer). We will consider a recent passer with strong

fundamentals in place of the experience requirement, and train you on our systems.

● Hands-on experience running month-end close and preparing financial statements — or, for a recent CPA

passer, the technical grounding to learn it quickly.

● Strong Excel skills.

● Strong attention to detail, with a record of accurate reconciliations and clean books.

● Clear written and spoken English for working with U.S. owners, vendors and project managers.

● Ability to work independently, meet close deadlines and manage several clients or entities at once.

● A real system for closing on time. You work from a checklist and a calendar, not memory, and you can say

exactly what is still open at any point in the close. You will be asked to show it.

● Discretion with sensitive financial information.

● Reliable computer, stable internet (≥100 Mbps) with a backup connection, and a backup-power plan.



Preferred Qualifications

● Hands-on AppFolio experience — or AppFolio certification or formal AppFolio training. We will train the right

candidate on our systems.

● Construction accounting: job costing, progress billing, retainage and WIP reporting.

● Real estate accounting: property-level books, rent rolls and owner reporting.

● Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, U.S. payroll basics and accrual accounting.

● Familiarity with QuickBase, CheckCentral, Buildertrend or Bluebeam.



The Boundaries of This Role

For clarity, and for your protection as much as ours, this role does NOT include:

● Approval authority over money. You prepare and reconcile payables and payment runs; the Owner approves

and releases them.



● Banking-portal credentials, wire initiation, check printing, or company card credentials.

● Signature authority or committing the Company to any agreement.

● Owner-relationship or commercial-terms decisions, or legal and rent-control work product.



What We Offer

● Full-time, remote, aligned to U.S. Pacific business hours.

● US$ 7.00 - 8.00 per hour, paid in USD via Wise.

● A monthly health allowance.

● A growth path toward a higher-level position — we promote from inside before we post outside.



How to Apply — Read Carefully

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following, exactly as described. Applications missing any

item will not be reviewed.

# Include with your application

1. Internet speed proof. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing at least 25 Mbps download, shared as a

Google Drive link.

2. A quick accounting check (show your work): On October 1, a company paid $18,000 for a 12-month

insurance policy. (a) How much insurance expense is recorded each month? (b) What is the prepaid

insurance balance on December 31? (c) Write the journal entry for October 31.

3. A short writing sample. Write a brief, professional
 to a project manager asking for missing

receipts for three corporate credit card charges. You need them before month-end close on the 5th.

4. Three short answers (a few sentences each): (a) How long have you used AppFolio, and which

accounting tasks did you handle in it? (b) How do you make sure nothing is missed during month-end

close? (c) Your internet provider and your backup plan for an internet outage and for a power outage.

5. Rate and availability. 



Why these? The accounting check and the writing sample mirror the daily work. Strong applications that follow

instructions move to a short skills test, a video interview, and reference checks.



Our Process

● Application review — we check that every item above is included and that the accounting check is correct.

● Short skills test (about 30 minutes) — reconcile a sample bank statement and post three month-end journal

entries in Excel.

● Final interview — a video call that walks through your test answers and covers experience and fit, including a

look at how you track a close.

● Reference checks, then offer.



Only candidates who pass the skills test reach the final interview, so interview time goes to proven applicants.

title: Social Media Manager & Strategy
description:
We are hiring a Content Strategist / Social Media Manager to plan, produce, and execute content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space.



This is a hybrid role. You will own the content planning process — building monthly plans, writing hooks, scripting videos, and tracking trends — AND you will execute that plan day to day: scheduling, publishing, managing the content calendar, and monitoring performance.



Content direction and final approval come from Keenya, but you are the person who turns her vision into a running system that never misses a beat.



You will have room to bring your own instincts to formatting, execution, and idea generation.



But this is not a role where you are setting the brand's overall strategic direction from scratch.





About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



We are a systems-driven team that moves fast, especially during launch periods, and we need someone who can keep pace without needing constant hand-holding.



What This Role Actually Is



You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule.



You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time.



We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own.



We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing.



What We Are Looking For



1. You can plan content that actually drives results

You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.



Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step.



2. You have a real feel for short vertical video

You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll.



You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly.



3. You can execute at volume, reliably

You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases.



You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled.



4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human

You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch.



You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy.



5. You are proactive, not just responsive

You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction.



You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan."



6. You are highly organized and communicative

You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes.



You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback.



7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner

This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it.



You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision.



What This Role Involves



Planning

Building monthly content plans with filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations

Tracking current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turning them into on-brand content ideas

Aligning every piece with content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals

A brief note on your experience executing content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — what platforms, what volume, what tools you have used

Your availability for a full-time role

How do you keep a content calendar organized when you are managing many pieces at once? What tools or systems do you use?

How do you make sure captions sound like the person who is posting them and not like generic marketing copy?

Tell us about a time you received feedback that changed your approach. How did you respond?

What does a healthy working relationship with a content owner look like to you, and how do you handle it when your ideas are not chosen?

Our team is small and works closely together. What do you enjoy most about collaborating on a creative team?

• New ad concepts go live every week, each with a clear brief and hypothesis.

• We have a set of winning ads per product and per market that we can scale.

Large corporations, Amazon aggregators, companies with many brands and B2B companies are not what we are looking for.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience with ads for European markets.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about ad creative. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company looking for one creative, resourceful person to make our social media content and support the business day to day.



You will create engaging, relatable short-form content for TikTok, Instagram, and
, and you will use AI tools to produce it quickly and well. You will also research trends, products, and competitors in depth, and you will help with assistant tasks such as
, scheduling, and spreadsheets.



This role fits you if the following points describe you.



• You already use AI tools for writing, images, and video in your own work.

• You know how social media algorithms work, and you keep up with every change.

• You follow new trends daily and use them while they are still rising.

• You are exceptionally creative and you think outside the box.

• You can show content you created and explain why it performed.

• You research thoroughly and find answers on your own.

• You care about the quality of your work and you meet deadlines.

• You like wearing many hats and learning new skills.



The role is remote for the entire shift, with availability during EST.



To apply, send three samples of your content and the list of AI tools you use to our inbox, with your cover letter.

title: Insurance Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
Leon Insurance Agency is a growing insurance agency based in California, USA. We are looking for an experienced, reliable, and motivated cold caller to join our team for a long-term position.



Your primary responsibility will be making outbound calls to potential customers, generating qualified insurance leads, and connecting interested prospects with our licensed insurance agents.



COMPENSATION & WORK SCHEDULE



$5 USD per hour, depending on experience



Monday through Friday



10:00 AM to 3:00 PM California Time (Pacific Time)



5 hours per day, 25 hours per week



Permanent work-from-home position



Paid training



Opportunity for performance-based raises



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



Make outbound calls to potential customers in the United States.



Generate interest in home, auto, and business insurance quotes.



Follow provided calling scripts while maintaining natural conversations.



Handle common objections professionally.



Follow up with interested prospects.



Update customer information and call dispositions in our CRM.



Meet daily calling and lead generation targets.



Communicate regularly with our insurance team.



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken English with clear, easily understood pronunciation.



Natural, confident, and professional phone presence.



At least one year of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience.



Experience using CRM software.



Ability to communicate effectively with American customers.



Stable, high-speed internet connection.



Reliable computer and quality noise-canceling headset.



Quiet, distraction-free working environment.



Punctual, dependable, coachable, and self-motivated.



Ability to consistently work California business hours.



PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED



Previous experience working for a U.S. insurance agency.



Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.



Experience in lead generation and outbound sales.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



Your updated résumé.



A mandatory 30-second English audio recording introducing yourself and explaining your cold calling experience. Please speak naturally rather than reading from a script.



A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Your expected hourly rate.



Confirmation that you can work the required schedule.



Please use "INSURANCE COLD CALLER – READY TO WORK" as your application subject line.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and is committed to growing with our agency.

title: Telecom Support Specialist
description:
UniVoxx is a fast-growing, software-based telecom company providing VoIP phone service and software to IT resellers, businesses, and call centers. We're looking for a Telecom Support Specialist to serve as a first point of contact for customers experiencing technical issues and emergencies with our VoIP platform during non business hours. (Weekdays: 6:00 PM EST to 10:00 PM EST and 6:00 AM EST to 8:30 AM EST.  Weekends: on-call). 



You will be expected to respond to urgent customer issues outside standard business hours, including nights and weekends. You will serve as front-line support via phone,
, and ticketing system. Diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to VoIP, networking, and telecom hardware/software. Own the customer experience end-to-end, escalating complex issues as needed. 



We average about 5-10 calls/tickets per week during after hours. This position would be paid a base salary for being "on-call" and a bonus for every emergency call answered and resolved. 



Qualifications include 2+ years in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Solid networking fundamentals — routers, switches, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, basic troubleshooting. Telecom or VoIP experience. Strong customer service skills; able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.

title: Social Media Content Creator — AI Video (Runway) + Reels for US Website Company
description:
I'm Mike, owner of Elvarrio — we build websites for US local businesses (plumbers, roofers, auto shops, cleaners, contractors) that don't have one yet.



I need a content creator to make a 15-post package for
 / Instagram / TikTok:



- 9 vertical videos (Reels/TikTok, 9:16, 15–30 sec) — AI video made with Runway (or similar: Kling, Pika, Luma) mixed with real footage and website screenshots I provide. Strong hook in the first 2 seconds, text overlays, music, captions burned in.

- 6 image/carousel posts — built from REAL screenshots of our live websites (I provide them) with bold text overlays. Do NOT generate the base images with AI — our audience can tell and it kills trust. AI is for video motion, not fake photos.



Captions + hashtags included for every post, written in a normal American small-business voice — like a regular guy, not a big agency.



YOU MUST HAVE:

- A portfolio with Runway / AI video examples I can watch — no portfolio, no reply

- Short-form video editing: CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects

- Proof you've made Reels/TikToks/Shorts for a business before (not just personal posts)

- Fast turnaround: first drafts within 48 hours of getting materials

- Good written English for captions



HOW HIRING WORKS (read this):

1. Reply with 2–3 links to your best AI video / Reel work — applications without links are deleted.

2. Shortlisted creators do a paid test: one 15-second Reel from my brief + footage. $20, paid whether I hire you or not.

3. Best test wins the 15-post package, with ongoing monthly work if it's good.



PAY:

- Paid test: $20

- 15-post package: $175 fixed (9 videos + 6 image posts, captions included, 2 revision rounds per post) — top pay for exceptional test quality

- Ongoing work available monthly after this package



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE 3 QUESTIONS:

1. Links to your 2–3 best AI video / Reel examples:

2. What AI video tools do you use? (Runway, Kling, Pika, other)

3. How fast can you deliver the paid test after I send the brief?

title: Director of Human Resources &  Talent  Acquisition
description:
The Director of Human Resources and Talent Acquisition leads recruitment and HR operations for a home healthcare organization serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, mental health disorders, and substance use disorders. The Director builds effective hiring, onboarding, employee relations, and retention practices to support a qualified, compassionate workforce.



This position reports to the CEO and works closely with department leaders and the Compliance and Training team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Lead recruitment for direct-care, clinical, administrative, and leadership positions.

- Partner with department leaders to identify staffing needs, develop job descriptions, and set hiring priorities.

- Oversee job postings, candidate screening, interviews, references, and offer processes.

- Lead onboarding and coordinate required background checks, registry searches, and employment documentation with the appropriate departments.

- Advise managers and leadership on employee relations, performance concerns, investigations, and corrective action.

- Maintain accurate and confidential personnel records.

- Oversee performance review, retention, and employee engagement practices.

- Track recruitment and workforce trends and recommend improvements.

- Coordinate with Compliance and Training to support required orientation, certifications, and audit readiness.



QUALIFICATIONS



- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.

- At least five years of progressive HR experience, including recruitment and employee relations.

- Experience leading an HR or talent acquisition function preferred.

- Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, disability services, or another direct-care setting preferred.

- Knowledge of employment requirements, HR systems, and confidential recordkeeping.

- Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and leadership skills.

- Commitment to respectful, person-centered services.



An HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR is preferred. Familiarity with Ohio DODD-related workforce requirements is also a plus.



WORK ENVIRONMENT



This role works with leadership, office staff, and frontline employees. Occasional travel to offices or service locations may be required.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to 
 and copy 
 include:



- Your professional resume

- A professional headshot

- A brief introduction video

- A short paragraph explaining why you feel you would be a good fit for this position



Schedule:

M,T,Th & Friday 9:00am-5:00pm

Wed-12pm-8pm

The organization is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable law.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: APPOINTMENT SETTER (REMOTE) | MEDICAL INDUSTRY | PART-TIME | EVENING AND WEEKEND AVAILABILITY REQUIRED
description:
A company in the medical industry is looking for a reliable and motivated Appointment Setter to join their remote team. This is a part-time remote position supporting a busy medical practice. Your primary role is to respond quickly to incoming leads through the CRM and guide them toward scheduling an appointment with the office. You will not be providing medical advice or diagnoses — your focus is entirely on connecting people with the team by getting them booked.



This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, communicates clearly, and genuinely wants to grow alongside a company that values its people. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working with people, and are comfortable in evening and weekend schedules, we want to hear from you.



This is a fully remote position.





SCHEDULE



- 20 hours per week

- Monday through Friday: approximately 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM Central Time

- Weekends: approximately 2 hours per day

- Start date: before end of year





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Monitor the CRM (Go High Level) and immediately follow up with incoming leads via chat

- Respond quickly and professionally to all new lead inquiries to maximize appointment bookings

- Focus conversations on scheduling — do not provide medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment recommendations

- Guide potential patients through the scheduling process and confirm appointments with the office

- Take phone calls when necessary or as a backup to chat-based communication

- Attend weekly team calls for training, performance feedback, and company updates

- Stay engaged with team goals and actively participate in the growth of the company

- Maintain strict confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA standards at all times





QUALIFICATIONS



- Previous experience in a HIPAA-compliant role is required

- Willing and able to sign a HIPAA agreement before starting

- Hands-on experience using Go High Level CRM functions

- Available to work evenings Monday through Friday (Central Time) and a couple of hours each day on weekends

- Comfortable on the phone when needed

- Strong written communication skills with a professional and friendly tone

- Ability to respond to leads quickly and with a sense of urgency

- Self-motivated, reliable, and punctual

- Eager to learn, improve, and grow with the company long-term





HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this role, please submit the following:



- Updated Resume

- Introduction Audio (Vacaroo is fine)

title: Customer Support & Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Overview:



This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Customer Support & Compliance Analyst supporting a financial institution that uses cryptocurrency and stablecoins to power its operations. This is a hybrid role, weighted toward compliance.



The majority of your time will be spent reviewing retail applicants from a compliance perspective: verifying identity documentation, requesting additional information, managing resubmissions, conducting customer due diligence and AML screening, and escalating high-risk cases. You'll work closely with the Compliance Manager to refine onboarding workflows and ensure adherence to global AML/CTF standards.



The remainder of your time will be spent on customer support: responding to customer inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining a high level of customer service. Much of the compliance review work is customer-facing, since it means communicating clearly with applicants about what's needed and why.



About Us:



We're an innovative, rapidly growing crypto-native financial platform on a mission to put users in control of their wealth, making it easy to save, earn, and spend crypto. Positioned as a leading decentralized finance platform, we offer a fully integrated, non-custodial product suite spanning staking, automated yield, and payments that bridges crypto utility with real-world convenience.



With billions in assets under management and a lean, agile team, we're building sustainable, secure, and scalable financial infrastructure to onboard the next billion users to crypto. Our offerings include liquid staking, automated yield strategies, and crypto-native payment solutions like credit cards, enabling a comprehensive decentralized banking experience.



As we continue to scale, we're actively hiring talented, mission-driven individuals who want to shape the future of finance from the ground up.



Required Qualifications:



• 1+ years of hands-on KYC/AML or retail onboarding experience at a fintech, payments, bank, or crypto company. This is a requirement, not a preference. We're looking for someone who has already done this work elsewhere and does not need to learn it here

• Direct experience reviewing retail applications end to end: document verification, discrepancy resolution, and making approve, reject, or escalate decisions

• Working knowledge of AML/CTF requirements, FATF standards, and KYC best practices for retail customers

• Hands-on familiarity with identity verification platforms and screening databases. Please name the specific tools you've used

• Excellent written and verbal English. Native or near-native fluency

• Excellent problem-solving skills

• Able to balance multiple high-urgency tasks, and ruthlessly prioritize

• Detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable handling sensitive customer data

• Personal experience with cryptocurrencies, and a strong understanding of how they work

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is preferred



You must be available to work 40 hours a week and have flexibility on shift timing.



To apply, please record a 1-2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, the KYC or AML work you've done previously, and the verification tools you've used.

title: Professional Amazon Seller Central Manager
description:
# Job Title: Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager- Minimum 7 years of experience required, and willing to work Eastern Standard Time; responsible, reliable, able to deliver results, and has worked exclusively on Amazon Seller Central. Only experienced candidates need apply. Experience should be specialized in Amazon services only.



**Company:** Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc.

**Industry:** Premium European Home Décor

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Contract (depending on experience)



## About Us



Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc. is a premium home décor brand offering high-quality European-made products, including tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and other elegant textile furnishings. We are focused on building a strong, premium presence on Amazon through exceptional listings, account management, and operational excellence.



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager** to take ownership of our Amazon catalog and day-to-day Seller Central operations. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to build, optimize, and manage high-converting Amazon listings while maintaining account health, operational efficiency, and premium brand presentation.



**Important:** This role does **not** include PPC/advertising management. We are specifically seeking a specialist in **Amazon listings and Seller Central management**.



## Role Overview



The Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Amazon product listings, maintaining catalog accuracy, improving conversion through better content execution, overseeing Seller Central operations, and ensuring that our Amazon storefront reflects the quality and premium positioning of our brand.



This person should be highly experienced with Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing variations, catalog troubleshooting, content optimization, image coordination, inventory monitoring, and account performance management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Amazon Listing Management & Optimization



* Create, upload, optimize, and maintain Amazon product listings for premium home décor products.

* Write and refine SEO-friendly product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ content briefs to improve discoverability and conversion.

* Manage parent-child variations, listing merges/splits, browse node issues, suppressed listings, stranded inventory issues, and catalog inconsistencies.

* Ensure listings accurately reflect product specifications, materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, and premium brand positioning.

* Continuously audit existing listings and identify opportunities to improve CTR, conversion rate, content quality, and overall customer experience.

* Coordinate with creative/design teams to improve listing images, infographics, comparison charts, lifestyle imagery, and premium content presentation.



### Seller Central Account Management



* Manage the day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central, excluding PPC.

* Monitor account health, voice of customer, listing quality dashboards, stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and performance notifications.

* Handle case log management and communicate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing, category, compliance, and catalog issues.

* Oversee catalog updates, SKU setup, variation corrections, pricing checks, and listing troubleshooting.

* Ensure product pages remain accurate, compliant, and optimized at all times.



### Inventory, Catalog & Operational Oversight



* Help manage product setup, SKU organization, and catalog structure for current and new launches.

* Monitor inventory levels and listing availability to help reduce stockouts and lost sales opportunities.

* Coordinate listing launches, updates, and seasonal content changes in an organized and timely manner.

* Maintain clean, structured Amazon catalog data and ensure consistency across listings.

* Assist in troubleshooting operational issues affecting listing visibility or sales performance.



### Performance & Growth Support



* Track listing-level performance metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, unit session percentage, sales trends, and Buy Box status.

* Identify underperforming listings and recommend actionable improvements in content, merchandising, images, or catalog structure.

* Work closely with ownership/management to support revenue growth through stronger listing quality, better catalog management, and improved customer-facing content.

* Provide regular reporting and recommendations on listing performance, catalog issues, account risks, and growth opportunities.



## Required Qualifications



* **Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing listings and account operations.

* Strong experience with **Amazon catalog management** and **listing optimization** in Seller Central.

* Proven experience creating and optimizing product listings that improve conversion and sales performance.

* Deep understanding of:



 * Amazon SEO and listing structure

 * Parent-child variations

 * Flat files and bulk uploads

 * Listing suppression issues

 * Inventory file templates

 * Seller Central troubleshooting

 * Account health and catalog compliance

* Experience managing Amazon listings for **premium consumer products**, ideally in home décor, furnishings, textiles, lifestyle, or similar categories.

* Strong written English and the ability to create polished, premium, customer-focused listing content.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying and solving issues.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of Amazon account operations.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with **premium home décor, textiles, furnishings, or lifestyle brands**.

* Strong understanding of how listing images, A+ content, and brand storytelling affect conversion.

* Experience working with premium or European-made products and presenting craftsmanship, material quality, and design heritage effectively on Amazon.

* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry and premium content execution.

* Ability to work strategically while also managing the day-to-day operational details of Seller Central.



## What Success Looks Like in This Role



* Amazon listings are fully optimized, accurate, visually compelling, and aligned with our premium brand.

* Catalog issues, suppressed listings, and operational problems are resolved quickly and proactively.

* Listing quality and conversion performance improve over time.

* Seller Central is organized, actively managed, and closely monitored.

* Product launches and updates are executed accurately and efficiently.

* The Amazon storefront reflects a polished, premium European home décor brand experience.



## To Apply



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction outlining your Amazon Seller Central experience.

2. Examples of Amazon listings or brands you have managed.

3. A summary of your experience with listing optimization, catalog troubleshooting, and Seller Central account management.

4. Any experience working with premium home décor, textiles, furniture, or lifestyle brands.

5. Your availability and preferred compensation structure.



## Important Note



This role is **not for PPC or advertising management**. We are specifically seeking an Amazon professional who excels in **listing management, catalog optimization, and overall Seller Central account management**.

title: Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist – Professional Etsy who can manage store and deliver sales
description:
**Job Title: Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist – Premium Home Décor**



We are seeking an experienced **Etsy Store Sales Growth Manager & Store Operations Specialist** to lead the growth and day-to-day management of our Etsy shop specializing in **premium European-inspired home décor**. Our collection includes **tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and Afghan-style home textiles**, with a focus on craftsmanship, storytelling, and elevated presentation.



This role is ideal for a professional who understands how to grow an Etsy store strategically—not just maintain listings, but actively increase traffic, conversion, average order value, and repeat purchases while preserving a premium brand image.



### About the Brand



We are a premium home décor business offering beautifully designed textile and decorative products for customers who appreciate timeless, elegant interiors. Our products include:



* Tapestries and wall hangings

* Cushion covers and decorative pillow covers

* Table runners and table linens

* Afghan throws and woven home accessories

* Other premium home décor textiles and accessories



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our Etsy store and help turn it into a stronger, more consistent sales channel.



### Key Responsibilities



**Etsy Store Growth & Sales Generation**



* Develop and execute a clear strategy to grow Etsy store revenue, traffic, and conversion rates

* Optimize the Etsy storefront for sales performance, customer experience, and premium brand presentation

* Identify opportunities to improve click-through rate, conversion rate, average order value, and repeat customer purchases

* Build promotional strategies around seasonal demand, holidays, gifting, home décor trends, and product launches

* Recommend pricing, bundling, and merchandising strategies to improve profitability and sales 
ntum

* Monitor competitors, market trends, keyword opportunities, and product positioning within the premium home décor category



**Listing Optimization & Merchandising**



* Create, optimize, and manage product listings for Etsy SEO and customer conversion

* Write compelling, high-converting titles, descriptions, product highlights, and storytelling-driven copy aligned with a premium brand voice

* Improve product presentation through strong listing structure, keyword strategy, and merchandising logic

* Advise on listing images, mockups, lifestyle content, video, and other visual elements that can improve conversion

* Organize product collections, cross-sell opportunities, and shop sections to enhance browsing and basket size



**Store Management & Daily Operations**



* Manage the day-to-day performance and upkeep of the Etsy store

* Ensure listings are accurate, complete, and updated for inventory, pricing, attributes, shipping settings, and policies

* Monitor shop health, customer experience, reviews, response times, and order-related issues

* Coordinate with the business owner/team regarding new products, stock updates, promotions, and priorities

* Maintain consistency in product presentation, brand messaging, and customer communication



**Analytics, Reporting & Performance Improvement**



* Track Etsy store performance and provide regular reporting on key KPIs such as:



 * Revenue growth

 * Conversion rate

 * Etsy traffic and traffic sources

 * Click-through rate

 * Best-selling products and underperforming listings

 * Return on promotions and campaigns

 * Average order value

* Use data to identify what is working, what is underperforming, and where action is needed

* Make proactive recommendations to improve store performance month over month



### Ideal Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who has a proven ability to **grow Etsy sales for product-based brands**, ideally within **home décor, textiles, interiors, gifts, lifestyle products, or premium handcrafted/elevated consumer goods**.



**Requirements**



* Proven experience managing and growing Etsy stores with measurable sales results

* Strong understanding of Etsy SEO, ranking factors, merchandising, and conversion optimization

* Experience writing compelling product listings and titles that balance keyword strategy with premium brand positioning

* Strong eye for product presentation, merchandising, and customer-facing storytelling

title: On-Camera Female Presenter for YouTube Videos (Men's Wellness & Relationships)
description:
We run a YouTube channel for men over 50 about relationships, intimacy, confidence and healthy habits.

- Ring light and a decent microphone, or willingness to get them

- Reliable and on time

- You should look mature (above 30, the older the better) since your audience is men over 50.



No experience needed. We'll guide you.

title: US Medical Billing / RCM Manager (Wound Care, Pacific Hours)
description:

ABOUT THE ROLE



The RCM Manager leads offshore AR, denials, payment posting, and credentialing teams across multiple US states. You will hire and train staff, maintain SOPs, run daily work lists and KPIs, and report weekly to the COO. This is a remote contractor role, not employment. Target start date: Monday, December 14, 2026.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Lead offshore teams for AR follow-up, denials and appeals, payment posting, and provider credentialing

- Hire, train, and coach staff; set expectations and review work quality

- Write and maintain SOPs for each major RCM function

- Run daily work lists and KPIs (AR aging, cash posted, timely-filing risk, first-pass acceptance, and credentialing follow-up dates)

- Keep each billing entity's records strictly separate

- Escalate blocked or high-risk issues quickly, with proof

- Deliver a clear weekly status report to the COO

- Follow HIPAA and company privacy rules at all times

- Refunds, reversals, adjustments, and write-offs require company approval



REQUIREMENTS



- 5+ years of US medical billing / revenue cycle experience, including Medicare, Medicaid, and Medicare Advantage

- Experience leading a team of 10 or more people

- Strong written and spoken English

- Stable internet and a quiet, private workspace

- Able to work full-time, Monday through Friday, with overlap of US Pacific business hours

- Able to sign a confidentiality agreement and a HIPAA / Business Associate agreement before any system access

- Work is done on a company-issued login in company systems only. No PHI, credentials, or payer files on personal devices, personal
, local drives, or unapproved cloud storage



PREFERRED



- Hands-on experience with Waystar and Net Health WoundExpert

- Wound care, home health, or multi-state specialty billing experience

- Experience writing SOPs, setting KPIs, and hiring or training remote billing staff



SCHEDULE



Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with overlap of US Pacific business hours. Remote contractor role. Target start: Monday, December 14, 2026.



PAY



Competitive, based on experience (this role is paid above $6 USD per hour). Paid as an independent contractor. No employment benefits.



SCREENING
