title: AI Creative Video Producer
description:
Realize Therapeutics is a US-based life sciences company developing consumer health and wellness products. Our Oxiceutics brand offers probiotic supplements, yogurt starter cultures, and other wellness products. We are seeking a talented Philippines-based individual to create useful, engaging videos with modern AI tools, existing media, product photography, and authentic footage recorded by our team and collaborators.

This is not a traditional filming position. No US travel is required. We are looking for an individual freelancer—not an agency—who enjoys visual storytelling, experimenting with new AI capabilities, and delivering excellent finished work.

This role is best suited for someone who thrives on ownership, pace, creativity, and execution rather than heavy process or large teams.



What you will do

• Create product introductions, educational explainers, how-to videos, yogurt-making troubleshooting clips, lifestyle content, and short-form social edits.

• Combine approved scripts, authentic smartphone footage, product photographs, existing videos, and AI-generated or AI-enhanced elements into cohesive finished videos.

• Develop storyboards and creative treatments for review before production.

• Repurpose archived media into fresh formats for websites, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, and other channels.

• Help transform practical customer questions into clear, accurate instructional content based on answers approved by our US team.

• Deliver appropriate exports, captions/transcripts when requested, and organized editable project files; communicate progress and meet agreed deadlines.

• Collaborate with our US creative, product, and technology colleagues, who provide approved messaging, brand/product governance, and AI workflow support.



What we are looking for

• 3–5 strong examples of finished commercial, educational, or social videos; clearly explain your personal contribution.

• Hands-on experience with current generative AI video, image, voice, and editing tools, plus excellent storytelling and visual judgment.

• Strong editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or comparable software; ability to combine real and generated media.

• Clear spoken and written English; reliable communication, organization, independence, and attention to detail.

• Interest in health, nutrition, wellness, science, or customer education.

• Based in the Philippines and available for occasional scheduled meetings overlapping US Central Time.



Helpful but not required

AI-assisted workflow automation, MCP integrations, media asset organization, and Amazon/Shopify video requirements. We value excellent finished work and adaptability more than any particular software platform.



Initial paid project: 60-second product video

We will provide product information, an approved script, product photography, and available footage. You will develop a storyboard or creative treatment for our approval, recommend how to combine the supplied materials with appropriate AI-assisted elements, then produce and edit the final 60-second video. We will assess creative quality, AI capability, accuracy, communication, and execution.

Please propose your fixed project fee for this assignment, or your hourly rate and estimated hours. This is a paid assignment for the selected freelancer, not a request for unpaid sample work. We may offer further projects or ongoing part-time collaboration if the fit is strong.



Compensation

Compensation will be fair and reflect experience, responsibilities, and the quality of work delivered. We are open to hourly or milestone-based arrangements and value a productive, mutually beneficial working relationship.



How to apply

• Share links to 3–5 of your best existing videos; identify which used AI and what you personally created.

• List the AI and editing tools you regularly use and give one example of how they improved a project.

• Quote your fixed fee or estimated hourly cost for the 60-second project.

• Provide your Philippines location, weekly availability, and ability to attend occasional US Central Time meetings.

• Briefly explain why this type of creative work interests you. Begin your proposal with the word “Glow.”

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Real Estate Executive Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our fast-paced real estate team.



This is not a passive administrative desk. You will bridge the gap between high-stakes contract-to-close transaction management and executive operations—working directly alongside our lead agent, external marketing and tech specialists, title/lender partners, and brokerage compliance.



Key Responsibilities

1. Contract-to-Close Transaction & Compliance Management

End-to-End File Management: Manage active buyer and seller files from executed contract through closing, recording, and post-close wrap-up (MLS closeout, lockbox/sign retrieval, utility transfers, and key/manual handoffs).



Brokerage Compliance & Commission Unblocking: Audit files in BoldTrail and TransactionDesk / Authentisign to ensure every required Arizona (AAR) form (SPDS, BINSR, ABAD, Buyer-Broker Agreements, signing certificates) is properly executed and uploaded within strict deadlines to prevent holds on Commission Disbursement Authorizations (CDAs).



Inspection & Repair Coordination: Track BINSR timelines, gather itemized contractor bids, coordinate termite/home-warranty orders, and compile clean repair-versus-credit packages for client review.



Title, Lender & Client Handoffs: Coordinate wire cutoffs, walkthrough schedules, pre-qualification uploads, and closing readiness updates across title officers, lenders, and clients.



2. Executive Operations & Vendor Coordination

Multi-Channel Triage & EOD Reporting: Monitor incoming requests across
, RingCentral/SMS, and team workspaces, translating rapid-fire updates into concrete deadlines (anchored to Arizona time) and delivering a structured End-of-Day (EOD) status report with task IDs, blockers, and links to proof.



Cross-Team Project Orchestration: Act as the central point of contact between the lead agent and external specialists (social media, video production, web/SEO, and bookkeeping)—tracking deliverable proofs without duplicating work.



Software, Billing & Brand Hygiene: Maintain our internal tools inventory, track software cancellations/disputes through to written confirmation, manage RingCentral call/voi
 routing, and ensure consistent HREG / EveryPlace branding across Zillow, Flexmls, Google Business Profile, and
 signatures.



3. CRM & Client Experience Operations

Database Integrity (Follow Up Boss): Maintain clean contact records, log detailed call/voi
 notes, segment audiences for targeted outreach, and enforce strict SMS "STOP" opt-out and data-retention rules.



Client Touchpoints & Tours: Prepare buyer tour itineraries/CMAs, send post-consultation seller prep checklists, and manage active-client communication preferences and listing alerts.



What We’re Looking For

Required Experience:



2+ years of experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator, Real Estate Executive Assistant, or Operations Manager (Arizona real estate experience and familiarity with AAR forms strongly preferred).



Proven proficiency in BoldTrail (or kvCORE), TransactionDesk / Authentisign, Follow Up Boss, Flexmls / ARMLS, Aligned Showings / Supra, and Google Workspace.



Experience working within RingCentral (or similar multi-line VoIP/SMS platforms).



Core Strengths:



Obsession with Closing Loops: You follow up persistently until you have written confirmation or an approved file in hand—never assuming an
 sent equals a task done.



Deadline Precision: When given a general timeframe ("tomorrow" or "soon"), you instinctively clarify exact clock cutoffs and manage schedules strictly on Arizona time.



Calm Under Shifting Priorities: You can drop a routine marketing audit to urgently clear a title wire hold, and seamlessly pick the audit back up afterward without dropping a single detail.



High Integrity & Discretion: Comfortable handling sensitive client records, wire/commission details, and account access protocols cleanly and securely.

title: Operations Manager (with Real Estate Experience)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly efficient Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growing organization. Because we rely heavily on AI to multiply our output, this is not a traditional middle-management position—we need a generalist leader with broad operational capability who can build systems, execute AI-driven projects, organize complex data, and lead a team of Virtual Assistants (VAs).



You will own the mechanics of how our business runs: from architecting our lead funnel and customer-touch processes to troubleshooting daily bottlenecks and coaching our team for maximum efficiency.

Qualifications



Proven Operational Range: Demonstrated experience in an Operations Manager, Chief of Staff, or senior integrator role where you wore multiple hats across systems, marketing operations, and client delivery.



High AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using modern AI tools (LLMs, workflow automation platforms like Zapier/Make, AI-assisted data tools) to streamline business operations—not just surface-level prompting.



Funnel & CRM Experience: Practical background building or managing lead pipelines, CRM workflows, and multi-channel customer touchpoints.



Remote Team Leadership: Track record of successfully managing and upskilling remote teams or Virtual Assistants, with a sharp eye for workflow efficiency and clear delegation.



Data & Systems Mindset: Strong organizational skills with the ability to audit messy processes, clean up databases, and build scalable, repeatable workflows.

title: Telemarketer
description:
B2B Appointment Setter & List Researcher — long-term, remote, paid hourly



THE ROLE



You call small and mid-sized businesses in Western Canada (BC and Alberta) and book short intro meetings between the person in charge of their employee benefits plan and our advisor. You are not selling insurance — you're booking a 30-minute conversation. A full operations manual, proven script and objection responses are provided.



Our clients tell us they stay with us for three things: sustainable rate savings, clarity in their coverage (no surprises at claim time), and an advisor who responds quickly, is patient, and acts in their best interest. Your call is a prospect's first taste of that experience — every call should sound like it.



This job is two jobs, and we value them equally:



-Calling (the visible half): friendly, unhurried cold calls during Pacific/Mountain business hours — gatekeepers, decision makers, objections, and booking meetings via Calendly.

-Research & data (the hidden half): verifying phone numbers and decision makers on company websites, enriching new lists before dialing, and keeping meticulous dated notes in our spreadsheet. The first pass through any new list is mostly cleanup — that is expected, and it's exactly why we pay by the hour, not per call.



YOU'RE A FIT IF



-Your spoken English is fluent and natural — you sound like a friendly colleague, not a script reader.

-You're meticulous: every dial logged the moment you hang up, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, notes a stranger could pick up and continue from.

-You're patient and steady — you'd rather build clean data and 3–6 solid meetings a week than burn through a list for volume.

-You're honest on the phone: comfortable saying “good question — that's exactly what the meeting is for” instead of bluffing.

-You want one long-term client and are reliably available during Canadian business hours.



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF



-You're paid-per-call minded: maximum dials, minimum notes, next gig.

-You find the research/data-entry half of the work beneath you.

-Your style is pressure, exaggeration, or arguing past a “no.”



THE ONE NON-NEGOTIABLE



You are our brand to every person you reach. Protecting the brand outranks any single meeting: courteous, honest, zero pressure, on every call. “Don't call again” is honoured forever. If a call turns sour, exit politely and log it.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



A complete operations manual with scripts and objection handling, a researched call list, spreadsheet conventions, Calendly for booking, and regular debriefs and coaching directly with the principal. We invest in one caller who gets better every month.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First two weeks: list enriched, script comfortable in your own words. Steady state: 100–150 dials a day, 15–25 real decision-maker conversations, 3–6 booked meetings a week — and a spreadsheet that's always current. Meetings booked and data quality are what we measure; dials are just how you get there.



HOW TO APPLY



Please don't send a resume or reply here — send a short video (2–3 minutes). Introduce yourself, tell us about your calling and research experience, and speak to us the way you'd speak to a business owner on a Tuesday morning. Then, so we know you actually read this page, finish your video by telling us the three things our clients say they stay with us for. Videos that skip that last part won't be considered — attention to detail is the job.

Marketing Operations Manager (Creative Team), DTC Beauty Brand, Full-Time, EST Hours



Description:



We're a DTC beauty brand at 8 figures, scaling to 9. Our creative team is the engine of the business: creative strategists write briefs and concepts, and video editors turn them into ads, shipping every single day.



We need the person who keeps that engine running at full speed. You'll work directly with our Head of Creative Strategy and Head of Video Editing as the creative team's operator.



The job in one line: make sure every editor is 100% occupied and running at 100% efficiency every day, and that every strategist and editor hits their KPIs.



This is a long-term, full-time engagement: 40 hours/week during EST business hours, as your main and only client.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Editor capacity: every editor has a full queue every day, with no idle time and no waiting on briefs

Editor efficiency: track each editor's output, turnaround time and revisions daily; flag bottlenecks and revision loops

End-of-day reports: check what each strategist and editor committed to against what actually got done

Follow-ups: two missed EOD reports means you follow up directly and flag it to their department head

Creative team KPIs: own the KPI tracker and know every week who's on track, who's behind, and why

The creative pipeline in ClickUp: brief → production → naming → launch handoff to the media buyer

Reporting: a daily snapshot and weekly report for the department heads and the founder



REQUIREMENTS (all required)



2+ years in marketing ops, creative ops, project management or EA roles, ideally at a DTC e-commerce brand or creative agency

Have managed or coordinated a team of video editors or designers

Understand how a video editing workflow runs (briefs, drafts, revisions, delivery)

Experience with Meta Ads, 
 or Triple Whale

Strong with ClickUp (or Asana/Monday), Google Sheets and Slack

Data-literate: comfortable tracking KPIs and spotting when numbers are off

Excellent written and spoken English

Available full-time on EST hours, with no other ongoing clients



TRAITS



Ownership: you treat the team's output as yours

Systems-minded: you build trackers so nothing depends on memory

Direct: you follow up with anyone, every day, without it getting awkward

Proactive: you flag problems the same day, not at the end of the week



COMPENSATION

$2,000/month



HOW TO APPLY



Apply on this link: 
/jobs/6b2680c2-2cb1-4ce4-846a-4e3e3be225e1



- Include a link to a 3-minute Loom in your proposal covering:

A tracker, dashboard or reporting system you've already built to track a team's output, and how the team used it

Your last two roles and why you left each



Please show a real system you've used with a team. Our Head of Creative Strategy reviews every Loom personally, and templates or sheets built just for this application won't move forward.

title: Amazon Seller Central- Specialist -PPC, Listing optimization & A+ Premium Design

# Amazon Growth Specialists for Premium Home Décor Brand: Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc



We are seeking experienced Amazon professionals to help scale and optimize our presence on Amazon. We are open to working with individual specialists or agencies and may hire one or more partners depending on expertise.



Our brand operates in the premium home décor category, where exceptional product presentation, strong organic visibility, and profitable advertising are critical to success.

Increase organic traffic, keyword rankings, and conversion rates by optimizing our product listings and improving discoverability across Amazon search results. Knowledge of Helium10 would be beneficial.

* Perform comprehensive keyword and competitor research.

* Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend search terms, and attributes.

* Improve listing structure and category placement.

* Develop ranking strategies for new and existing products.

* Monitor keyword performance and identify opportunities for organic growth.

* Analyze competitor listings and recommend improvements.

* Continuously test and refine listing copy to improve conversion rates.

* Identify catalog, indexing, and suppression issues and implement solutions.



### Desired Outcomes



* Increased organic sales.

* Higher rankings for priority keywords.

* Improved conversion rates.

* Increased product visibility and click-through rates.

* Reduced reliance on paid advertising for growth.



### Ideal Experience



* Proven success growing Amazon brands through SEO and listing optimization.

* Experience in premium consumer products, home décor, furniture, lifestyle, or luxury categories.

* Strong understanding of Amazon search algorithms and marketplace best practices.

* Experience with Helium 10, Data Dive, SellerSprite, or similar tools.



---



# 2. Amazon PPC & Advertising Specialist



### Mission



Drive profitable revenue growth through strategic management and optimization of Amazon advertising.



### Responsibilities



* Develop and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Build campaign structures designed for both growth and profitability.

* Conduct keyword research and audience targeting analysis.

* Optimize bids, placements, budgets, and campaign segmentation.

* Manage advertising strategy for product launches and seasonal promotions.

* Analyze search term performance and identify scaling opportunities.

* Monitor competitive advertising activity within our category.

* Deliver ongoing reporting and recommendations.



### Desired Outcomes



* Increased revenue from Amazon advertising.

* Improved ROAS and TACOS performance.

* Efficient budget utilization.

* Sustainable scaling of profitable campaigns.

* Strong launch performance for new products.



### Ideal Experience



* Demonstrated track record managing Amazon PPC for established brands.

* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.

* Experience managing significant advertising budgets.

* Familiarity with premium or luxury consumer brands preferred.



---



# 3. Amazon Premium Brand Content & Creative Specialist



### Mission



Create a best-in-class Amazon shopping experience that reflects the quality, craftsmanship, and premium positioning of our home décor brand.



### Responsibilities



#### Premium Product Imagery



* Audit and improve existing product image galleries.

* Create conversion-focused infographics and feature callouts.

* Develop lifestyle imagery that showcases products in beautifully designed spaces.

* Ensure all imagery reinforces a premium brand aesthetic.

* Recommend image strategies that improve customer confidence and conversion rates.



#### A+ & Premium A+ Content



* Design and develop compelling A+ Content and Premium A+ Content modules.

* Create visual product stories that communicate quality, craftsmanship, materials, and design details.

* Build content that encourages cross-selling and collection discovery.

* Optimize layouts for both desktop and mobile experiences.

* Improve navigation, collection merchandising, and visual consistency.

* Create a cohesive brand experience across all Amazon touchpoints.



### Desired Outcomes



* Increased conversion rates.

* Stronger premium brand perception.

* Improved customer engagement with content.

* Increased average order value and cross-category purchases.

* Elevated visual presentation versus competitors.



### Ideal Experience



* Portfolio demonstrating exceptional Amazon A+ and Premium A+ Content.

* Experience working with luxury, premium, home décor, furniture, design, or lifestyle brands.

* Strong visual storytelling and eCommerce merchandising expertise.

* Understanding of Amazon creative best practices and image compliance requirements.



### Portfolio Requirements



Please provide examples of:



* Amazon A+ Content

* Premium A+ Content

* Product image galleries

* Brand Store designs

* Home décor, furniture, luxury, or premium consumer brands (preferred)



---



## Proposal Requirements

* Relevant Amazon case studies.

* Brands and categories managed.

title: Remote Claims Specialist
description:
# Claims Specialist (m/f/d) – Remote



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Independent Contractor**



## Join IronMaxx – #BEcomeMAXX!



At IronMaxx, we're passionate about sports nutrition, performance, and growth. As an international sports nutrition brand based in Germany, our products reach customers through leading retailers, discounters, drugstores, and online marketplaces across Europe.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Claims Specialist (m/f/d) to strengthen our international Finance team.



Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and persistent when it comes to resolving financial discrepancies? Do you enjoy investigating complex cases, challenging unjustified deductions, and ensuring that every claim is properly resolved?



Then we want to hear from you!



## Your Mission



As our Claims Specialist, you will take ownership of customer claims and payment deductions, ensuring that every deduction is investigated, supported by evidence, and resolved efficiently.



Working closely with our Claims Manager in Germany, you'll play an important role in protecting our revenue, improving financial accuracy, and building efficient claims management processes.



## Your Responsibilities



- **Claims Management:** Record, investigate, and manage customer deductions, including delivery shortages, returns, pricing discrepancies, promotional charges, and delivery penalties.

- **Dispute Resolution:** Review claims against contractual agreements, invoices, and delivery documentation, challenging unjustified deductions with clear supporting evidence.

- **Accounts Receivable Reconciliation:** Match customer payments, deductions, and outstanding invoices using SAP Business One, ensuring accurate documentation and resolution.

- **Stakeholder Coordination:** Collaborate with Sales, Logistics, Accounting, external warehouses, carriers, and suppliers to obtain documentation and resolve discrepancies.

- **Recovery Management:** Identify financial losses caused by logistics partners or suppliers and support recovery claims.

- **Case Ownership:** Independently manage your claims portfolio, prioritise cases, meet deadlines, and ensure accurate tracking through to closure.

- **Reporting & Analysis:** Prepare regular claims reports, monitor outstanding cases, identify recurring issues, and recommend process improvements.

- **Month-End Support:** Assist with reconciliations and ensure claims-related adjustments are accurately reflected in financial records.



## What You Bring



- Professional experience in **claims management, customer deductions, accounts receivable, dispute resolution, or order-to-cash processes**.

- Ideally, experience in **FMCG, consumer goods, retail, e-commerce, or logistics**.

- A strong understanding of customer deductions, payment discrepancies, and invoice reconciliation.

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as **SAP Business One, SAP, NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics**.

- Strong **Excel skills**, including XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and working with large datasets.

- Excellent **English communication skills**, both written and spoken.

- An analytical, detail-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

- A proactive and persistent approach, with the ability to independently manage cases and follow them through to resolution.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams.



**Nice to Have:**

- Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, retailer supplier portals, or EDI processes.

- Familiarity with European retail customers and logistics documentation.

- Basic German language skills.

- A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.



## What We Offer



- **100% Remote:** Work from your home office while collaborating with our team in Germany.

- **Long-Term Opportunity:** A full-time, long-term collaboration as an independent contractor.

- **International Environment:** Become part of a growing international sports nutrition brand.

- **Structured Onboarding:** Receive comprehensive training, clear procedures, and support from our experienced claims team.

- **Ownership & Impact:** Take responsibility for your own portfolio and actively contribute to improving our claims processes.

- **Growth & Development:** Be part of a growing Finance function with evolving processes, digital tools, and opportunities to contribute your ideas.

- **Collaborative Team:** Work closely with colleagues across Finance, Sales, and Logistics in an international environment.



## Key Details



- **Location:** 100% Remote (Home Office)

- **Employment Model:** Full-Time, Independent Contractor

- **Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM German time

- **Reporting Line:** Claims Manager, Germany

- **Start Date:** As soon as possible



## Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?



If you're passionate about accuracy, enjoy solving complex financial challenges, and want to make a measurable impact in a growing international company, we'd love to get to know you!



**Apply now and become part of the IronMaxx team!**

title: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)
description:
We're Hiring: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time

Industry: Real Estate / Cash Home Buying



About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, persistent, and relationship-driven Follow-Up Specialist to manage and nurture inbound seller leads.



In this role, you'll take ownership of the lead follow-up process, ensuring every inquiry receives timely attention and no potential opportunity gets lost in the pipeline.



You'll serve as the bridge between inbound leads and the acquisitions team, building meaningful connections with prospective sellers through consistent, personalized, and empathetic communication.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, thrives in a high-volume environment, and understands that successful follow-up requires both persistence and genuine relationship-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Lead Response & Management

- Contact every new inbound lead within 10 minutes of receiving an inquiry, primarily through phone calls.

- Make multiple contact attempts throughout the day for leads that have not yet been reached.

- Prioritize new inquiries to ensure timely engagement and prevent missed opportunities.

- Record all calls, conversations, and follow-up activities in the CRM.

2. Daily Lead Follow-Up & Campaign Management

- Work through prioritized lead lists daily, following the established urgency and contact cadence.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules across different lead stages:

  - Recent leads (0–7 days): 3–5 contact attempts per week.

  - Leads (8–30 days): 2–3 contact attempts per week.

  - Older leads (1–6 months and 6+ months): Maintain regular follow-up campaigns.

- Review and work through missed follow-up tasks at least once every two weeks.

- Alternate between dialer campaigns and click-to-call strategies to maximize contact and answer rates.

3. Relationship Building & Communication

- Build rapport with prospective sellers through genuine, empathetic, and conversational interactions.

- Understand each seller's circumstances, which may include divorce, foreclosure, inherited properties, or financial challenges.

- Personalize conversations based on each lead's situation rather than relying solely on scripted communication.

- Follow up through phone calls, text messages, and
s when prospects are unavailable.

4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records after every interaction, including notes, lead status, and next follow-up dates.

- Track qualified leads successfully passed to the acquisitions team.

- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates on lead conversions.

- Identify recurring patterns, opportunities, and challenges, and communicate relevant insights to leadership.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent phone communication skills with a warm, confident, and natural conversational style.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage a high-volume follow-up pipeline.

- High levels of discipline, accountability, and consistency.

- Strong emotional intelligence and empathy when dealing with sellers in sensitive or challenging situations.

- Persistent and proactive, without being overly aggressive or pushy.

- Excellent written communication skills, particularly for personalized text messages and
s.

- Comfortable making a high volume of daily calls.

- Strong attention to detail, especially in CRM documentation and data management.

- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in outbound calling, inside sales, lead management, appointment setting, or customer service.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, particularly Podio.

- Experience using auto-dialers or power dialers, such as BatchDialer.

- Background in real estate, property management, or sales-driven environments is an advantage.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

- Familiarity with team communication tools such as Slack.

No real estate experience? That's okay! Full training on processes, systems, and workflows will be provided. We're more interested in your willingness to learn, adaptability, and ability to follow through.



Tools & Platforms

- CRM: Podio

- Auto-Dialer: BatchDialer or similar power dialer

- Communication: Slack

- Productivity Tools: Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel



How Success Is Measured

- Lead Response Time: New inbound leads contacted within 10 minutes.

- Follow-Up Completion: 100% of scheduled follow-up tasks completed on time.

- Campaign Pass Rate: Number of qualified leads successfully handed off to the acquisitions team.

- Contact Rate: Percentage of leads successfully reached through outreach efforts.

title: Behavioral Health Medical Biller & Credentialing Specialist | IOP + Outpatient
description:
We are a Behavioral Health facility  provider in Florida. We offer outpatient mental health services and substance use intensive outpatient treatment (IOP) for adults and adolescents. We will open PHP soon. We serve people in recovery, trauma survivors, veterans, and families in our community.



We’re preparing to submit our first insurance claims and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term. Your first priority will be helping us get claims out accurately, follow them through payment, and keep our most important payer applications moving.



What you’ll do

- Handle billing from benefits verification through payment. Verify eligibility and benefits before the first visit, confirm authorization requirements, and track approved visits and expiration dates.

- Prepare IOP and outpatient claims. Use UB-04/837I or CMS-1500/837P according to the payer and contract. Verify IOP per diem codes, revenue codes, modifiers, place of service, provider information, and authorizations. Flag documentation issues for the clinical team before submission.

- Follow claims through resolution. Correct clearinghouse rejections, work denials and underpayments, submit appeals, post payments from ERAs and EOBs, and reconcile payments.

- Support facility contracting and clinician credentialing. Track applications under our Type 2 organizational NPI, maintain clinician rosters and CAQH profiles, and verify approved services and effective dates. Payers may include Florida Medicaid plans, commercial insurers, VA Community Care, TRICARE, Medicare, and EAPs, depending on our enrollment priorities.

- Help set up our billing workflow. Coordinate EDI, ERA, and EFT enrollments, work in Availity and payer portals, and help test claims in our new EHR and Stedi workflow using test data.

- Keep us updated. Send a short weekly summary of claims, payments, denials, and pending payer applications. Help document billing procedures as we grow.



What we’re looking for

- At least three years of U.S. medical billing experience, including behavioral health and hands-on denial follow-up.

- Experience with both institutional and professional claims. Direct experience billing substance use IOP or PHP is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on payer enrollment or credentialing experience. Facility contracting under a Type 2 NPI is strongly preferred.

- Experience with Medicaid managed care and commercial insurance. Florida payer experience, especially with Molina, Aetna, Cigna/Evernorth, or Optum, is a plus.

- Experience with single case agreements, rate requests, payer audits, or recoupment appeals is a plus. CPB, CPC, or CRCR certification is welcome.

- Clear spoken and written English, reliable internet, and a private workspace. Must complete privacy onboarding and follow our HIPAA and substance use record confidentiality procedures.



How to apply

Attach  your résumé or relevant work history with dates, your Eastern Time availability, and brief answers to these questions.



1. Which behavioral health programs have you personally billed for? Include the services, payers, and claim formats you used. If you’ve billed IOP, explain what you would verify before submitting one day of service to a Florida Medicaid plan and a commercial plan.



2. Have you worked on a facility contract under a Type 2 NPI or negotiated a single case agreement? Tell us which payer was involved, what you personally handled, and what happened.



3. Tell us about a denial, underpayment, or recoupment you worked on. What caused it, what did you do, and what was the result?



4. As a start up explain how you can help us grow and if you have prior experience in this



5. PLEASE ONLY apply if you have experience.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions VA (Inland Empire, CA
description:
About me

I'm a real estate investor buying fixers and small multifamily (1–4 units) in the Inland Empire: San Bernardino, Highland, Colton, Rialto and Fontana. I focus on closing deals and running renovations. I need an experienced VA to run everything else on the deal-finding side.



What you'll do



 • Find deals: search the MLS, Zillow and Redfin daily for stale listings, price cuts, fixers, probate and expired listings.

 • Pull lists: absentee owners, free-and-clear properties, long-time owners, vacant homes and pre-foreclosures, using PropStream, DealMachine or BatchLeads.

 • Find owner contact info and manage it in a CRM.

 • Reach out to sellers by phone, text or mail, following DNC and TCPA rules.

 • Run the numbers: after-repair value from sold comps, rent comps, a rough repair estimate, and the maximum offer.

 • Follow up with sellers and agents until there's a yes or a no.

 • Coordinate with agents, contractors, lenders and escrow, and keep my calendar and pipeline organized.

 • Send me a weekly report: leads, conversations, offers made, and deals in progress.



Must have



 • 2+ years of US real estate investing experience (acquisitions, wholesaling or underwriting)

 • Hands-on experience with PropStream, DealMachine or BatchLeads, plus a CRM (Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel or similar)

 • Can pull comps and explain an after-repair value

 • Understands seller financing and creative deal structures

 • Strong written and spoken English

 • Available to work during Pacific time business hours



Nice to have



 • California or Inland Empire market experience

 • Cold calling experience with a track record you can show

 • Experience working with contractors or project management



Pay: Hourly pay plus a bonus for every deal I close that you found.



How to apply (this is the test)



Find one real property in San Bernardino, Highland, Colton or Rialto that you think is a good deal, and send me:



 1.  The address and listing link (or how you found it if it's off-market)

 2.  The asking price, beds and baths, square footage, and year built

 3.  The after-repair value, backed by 3 sold comparable homes (addresses, sale prices, dates)

 4.  A repair estimate, with what needs fixing

 5.  The maximum offer, using after-repair value × 70% − repairs

 6.  Why the seller might be motivated: time owned, days on market, price cuts, vacancy, and so on

 7.  Whether the seller could offer financing, and why you think so

 8.  Rent estimate for keeping it as a rental (with rent comps)



Rules:

 • Start your application with the word "HIGHLAND" so I know you read the whole post.

 • Applications without a deal won't be reviewed.



Deadline: The top 2–3 applicants get a paid trial week before I hire.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Schedule: At least 5 hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours



About the Role



Triple Line Brands is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to support the day-to-day advertising work for consumer brands across their Amazon marketplaces.

This is an execution and analysis-focused role. You will carry out advertising plans set by a Senior Amazon PPC Strategist, build and optimize campaigns, maintain account hygiene, analyze performance data, and prepare accurate reports. The Strategist will own account strategy and higher-judgment decisions, while you will own the accuracy, quality, documentation, and timely completion of assigned PPC work.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, identifying inconsistencies, following structured processes, and translating clear performance targets into specific campaign changes.





What You’ll Do



Build, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns based on approved advertising plans.

Conduct keyword and product-targeting research, search-term analysis and harvesting, negative targeting, and routine account reviews.

Translate account-specific ROAS, ACOS, CPC, conversion, and budget-pacing goals into appropriate bid, placement, targeting, and budget adjustments.

Download, organize, analyze, and validate advertising and performance data using Excel or Google Sheets.

Review datasets, reports, and dashboards for missing information, duplicates, incorrect filters, formula errors, unusual results, and inconsistencies between sources.

Monitor sales, spend, TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, and other relevant performance measures.

Diagnose significant performance gaps or fluctuations, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions for Strategist review.

Compile, check, and submit PPC performance reports accurately and on time.

Maintain campaign hygiene, including organized structures, naming conventions, targeting, budgets, and campaign uptime.

Document campaign changes, actions taken, test progress, results, and follow-up items.

Support the Senior PPC Strategist with data preparation, reporting, account research, audits, and other PPC-related tasks that help brands progress toward their goals.

Flag risks, blockers, unclear instructions, data issues, or decisions outside your guidelines to the Senior PPC Strategist.

Apply department standards and share practical feedback that could improve campaign execution, reporting, quality assurance, and team workflows.





What We’re Looking For



At least two years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience, with the full two years spent managing multiple Amazon advertising accounts or marketplaces at the same time for established consumer brands with meaningful ad spend.

Amazon agency experience is preferred.

Comfortable managing approximately 10 to 12 substantive brand-marketplace assignments when fully ramped, subject to account complexity and workload capacity.

Strong data analysis skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Experience reviewing and validating PPC datasets, reports, dashboards, or analytical models.

Ability to diagnose performance problems, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions.

Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, bidding, placements, budget management, keyword targeting, product targeting, search-term harvesting, and negative targeting.

Ability to translate quantified performance goals into specific campaign optimization actions.

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filters, and data validation.

Ability to identify reporting errors, inconsistencies between data sources, and meaningful changes in account performance.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to learn new brands, products, tools, and workflows quickly.

Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple accounts and evolving priorities.

Organized, dependable, receptive to feedback, and proactive about communicating risks, blockers, and opportunities to improve team processes.

Familiarity with Helium 10, SmartScout, My Real Profit, Atom11, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Amazon DSP experience is a strong advantage, with advanced proficiency preferred but not required.

Experience working remotely with US-based brands or cross-functional teams is an advantage.





Why Join Us



You’ll work on a varied portfolio of Amazon brands with clear strategic direction and defined performance goals. You’ll receive account-specific coaching from a Senior PPC Strategist and support from advertising leadership while strengthening your campaign execution, data analysis, and reporting skills.





How to Apply



Please include a link to your résumé in your application and make sure we have permission to view it. If you have a portfolio of relevant Amazon PPC work, feel free to include a link to it as well.





Salary posted is negotiable

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Must Have (intermediate to advanced)



- Microsoft 365 administration: users, licenses, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, MFA, and Exchange Online basics

- Networking: IP addressing and subnets, DNS, DHCP, routing basics, VPNs, and firewalls

- Diagnosing connectivity and call quality issues such as packet loss, latency, and jitter, and knowing how to test for them

- At least 2 years in a hands-on Level 1/Level 2 support role, ideally at an MSP



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers, email, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use our RMM platform (NinjaOne) for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Work with our endpoint security platform (SentinelOne), including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Prior NinjaOne or SentinelOne experience is a plus but not required; we will train you

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone, email, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:



- Technically experienced and naturally curious

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Interested in VoIP, communications, cloud technology, and AI

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**

**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**



Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.



### How to Apply (voice recording required)



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



Record a 1 to 2 minute voice recording of yourself speaking to a customer as if you were on the phone: their whole office lost phone service 20 minutes ago, they're upset, and their clients are calling them. Explain what you're doing and what happens next.



Upload the recording to Vocaroo (vocaroo.com), Google Drive, or a similar service, make sure anyone with the link can listen, and paste the link at the top of your application message.



In your application message, also include:

- Your monthly pay expectation in USD

- Whether you can reliably work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern, Monday to Friday

title: Creative Strategist | DTC Ecommerce & Performance Creative | Part-Time
description:
We are a growing North American e-commerce children's brand creating culturally representative toys and gifts.



We're looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to become the creative brain behind our paid and organic content, with a strong focus on Meta advertising.



We already have a marketing team, graphic designers, video editors and a media buying agency. We need someone who can proactively identify what creative we should produce, why it will resonate with customers and how it will drive sales.



This is a creative strategy role, not a media buying or social media management position.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



- Research customer psychology, buying motivations, objections, competitors and creative trends.

- Develop compelling selling angles, creative concepts, hooks, scripts and storyboards.

- Analyze paid and organic creative performance to identify what's working, what's not and why.

- Develop structured creative testing and iteration strategies for Meta ads.

- Proactively identify creative gaps and opportunities before performance declines.

- Create actionable briefs for designers, video editors, UGC creators and ambassadors.

- Provide creative direction and constructive feedback to our production team.

- Develop organic and founder-led storytelling concepts that build brand awareness and drive purchase intent.

- Identify opportunities to repurpose existing footage, photography and winning content.

- Develop creative strategies around product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns and different audiences.

- Provide weekly creative insights and actionable recommendations on what to continue, change, stop and test next.



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Proven creative strategy experience with DTC e-commerce brands.

- Strong understanding of Meta advertising and performance creative.

- Excellent storytelling, copywriting, hook development and scriptwriting skills.

- Strong customer research and consumer psychology skills.

- Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into creative decisions.

- Experience developing structured creative testing strategies.

- Ability to guide designers, video editors and content creators.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Proactive, resourceful and able to work independently.



## BONUS EXPERIENCE



- Children's products, parenting, lifestyle or gifting brands.

- Founder-led content and UGC strategy.

- Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Klaviyo or GA4.

- Video editing or graphic design.

- North American consumer markets.



## WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT



We don't want someone who simply follows trends, generates generic ideas or tells us to "make more creatives."



We want someone who can explain why a creative works, identify what needs to improve and develop specific, thoughtful concepts that our team can execute.



We're a bootstrapped, mission-driven business that values authentic storytelling, creative efficiency, profitability and measurable results.



This is a part-time, remote position with the potential for a long-term relationship and growth.



## TO APPLY



Please complete our application form:







Include examples of creative strategies, scripts, briefs or campaigns you personally developed, along with performance results where available.



Applications without a completed form will not be reviewed.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~10 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (~15 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours

5:30 AM – 7:30 AM PHT (10:30 AM – 12:30 PM NZDT)



These hours are required each business day for core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Mondays), and communication with the New Zealand team.



Candidates should have some flexibility outside these hours to address urgent or time-sensitive matters, ensuring outstanding tasks are resolved before the following business day.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately ~15 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.
